Expand source code 
@ATTENTION_REGISTRY.register(
    "compressed_attention_layer",
    supports_causal=True,
    supports_bidirectional=True,
    supports_gqa=True,
)
@ATTENTION_REGISTRY.register(
    "compressed_attention",
    supports_causal=True,
    supports_bidirectional=True,
    supports_gqa=True,
)
class CompressedAttentionLayer(BaseAttention):
    supports_causal: bool = True
    supports_bidirectional: bool = True
    supports_gqa: bool = True
    supports_rope: bool = True
    is_custom_attention: bool = True

    def __init__(
        self,
        config: Any | None = None,
        rank: int | None = None,
        rank_qkv: int = 256,
        rank_out: int = 256,
        lora_rank: int = 16,
        original_layer: Any = None,
        pretrained_attn: nn.Module | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        cfg = config if config is not None else original_layer
        super().__init__(cfg, rank)
        self.adapter = ModelAdapter(cfg)
        self.hidden_size: int = self.adapter.hidden_size or kwargs.get(
            "hidden_size", kwargs.get("d_model", 768)
        )
        self.num_heads: int = self.adapter.num_heads or kwargs.get(
            "num_heads", kwargs.get("num_attention_heads", 12)
        )
        self.num_kv_heads: int = self.adapter.num_key_value_heads or kwargs.get(
            "num_kv_heads", kwargs.get("num_key_value_heads", self.num_heads)
        )
        self.head_dim: int = self.adapter.head_dim or (self.hidden_size // max(1, self.num_heads))
        self.all_head_size: int = self.num_heads * self.head_dim
        self.kv_head_size: int = self.num_kv_heads * self.head_dim
        self.kv_repeat: int = max(1, self.num_heads // max(1, self.num_kv_heads))
        _mt = getattr(cfg, "model_type", "").lower() if cfg else ""
        _decoder_prefixes = (
            "gpt",
            "qwen",
            "llama",
            "mistral",
            "gemma",
            "phi",
            "opt",
            "bloom",
            "falcon",
            "olmo",
            "mpt",
            "stablelm",
        )
        self.is_decoder: bool = bool(
            getattr(cfg, "is_decoder", False) or any(_mt.startswith(p) for p in _decoder_prefixes)
        )
        self.is_nested_encoder: bool = False

        rank_val = rank or kwargs.get("rank_qkv", rank_qkv)
        self.rank_qkv = min(rank_val, self.all_head_size + 2 * self.kv_head_size, self.hidden_size)
        self.rank_out = min(
            rank or kwargs.get("rank_out", rank_out),
            self.all_head_size,
            self.hidden_size,
        )
        self.lora_rank = getattr(cfg, "lora_rank", lora_rank)
        self.lora_scaling = (32.0 / self.lora_rank) if self.lora_rank > 0 else 1.0

        qkv_out_dim = self.all_head_size + 2 * self.kv_head_size

        # Frozen base SVD parameters
        self.Vh_qkv = nn.Parameter(
            torch.randn(self.rank_qkv, self.hidden_size) * 0.02, requires_grad=False
        )
        self.S_qkv_sqrt = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(self.rank_qkv), requires_grad=False)
        self.U_qkv = nn.Parameter(
            torch.randn(qkv_out_dim, self.rank_qkv) * 0.02, requires_grad=False
        )
        self.bias_qkv = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(qkv_out_dim), requires_grad=False)

        self.Vh_out = nn.Parameter(
            torch.randn(self.rank_out, self.all_head_size) * 0.02, requires_grad=False
        )
        self.S_out_sqrt = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(self.rank_out), requires_grad=False)
        self.U_out = nn.Parameter(
            torch.randn(self.hidden_size, self.rank_out) * 0.02, requires_grad=False
        )
        self.bias_out = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(self.hidden_size), requires_grad=False)

        # Trainable LoRA residual adapters
        if self.lora_rank > 0:
            self.lora_A_qkv = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.lora_rank, self.hidden_size))
            self.lora_B_qkv = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(qkv_out_dim, self.lora_rank))
            self.lora_A_out = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.lora_rank, self.all_head_size))
            self.lora_B_out = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.hidden_size, self.lora_rank))
            self.reset_lora_parameters()
        else:
            self.register_parameter("lora_A_qkv", None)
            self.register_parameter("lora_B_qkv", None)
            self.register_parameter("lora_A_out", None)
            self.register_parameter("lora_B_out", None)

        dropout_p = (
            getattr(cfg, "dropout", getattr(cfg, "attention_probs_dropout_prob", 0.1))
            if cfg
            else 0.1
        )
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout_p)
        self.rotary_emb = getattr(pretrained_attn, "rotary_emb", None)

        src = pretrained_attn or (
            original_layer
            if hasattr(original_layer, "q_lin")
            or hasattr(original_layer, "query")
            or hasattr(original_layer, "c_attn")
            else None
        )
        if src is not None:
            self.copy_weights(src)

    @property
    def qkv_weight(self) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Reconstruct the effective base QKV weight from SVD factors."""
        return (self.U_qkv * self.S_qkv_sqrt.view(1, -1)) @ (
            self.Vh_qkv * self.S_qkv_sqrt.view(-1, 1)
        )

    @property
    def out_weight(self) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Reconstruct the effective base Out weight from SVD factors."""
        return (self.U_out * self.S_out_sqrt.view(1, -1)) @ (
            self.Vh_out * self.S_out_sqrt.view(-1, 1)
        )

    def reset_lora_parameters(self) -> None:
        if self.lora_rank > 0:
            nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.lora_A_qkv, a=math.sqrt(5))
            nn.init.zeros_(self.lora_B_qkv)
            nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.lora_A_out, a=math.sqrt(5))
            nn.init.zeros_(self.lora_B_out)
            self.lora_A_qkv.requires_grad = True
            self.lora_B_qkv.requires_grad = True
            self.lora_A_out.requires_grad = True
            self.lora_B_out.requires_grad = True

    def copy_weights(self, src: Any) -> None:
        from neuralops.core.adapters import UniversalAdapter

        extracted: dict[str, tuple[torch.Tensor | None, torch.Tensor | None]] = {
            "q": (None, None),
            "k": (None, None),
            "v": (None, None),
            "o": (None, None),
        }

        # 1. HuggingFace / standard UniversalAdapter extraction
        for proj in ["q", "k", "v", "o"]:
            try:
                w, b = UniversalAdapter.get_weight_bias(src, proj)
                if w is not None:
                    extracted[proj] = (w, b)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.debug(
                    f"UniversalAdapter failed for {proj}: {e}"
                )  # continue to fallback paths

        # 2. GPT-2 Fused c_attn Conv1D handling
        if hasattr(src, "c_attn") and (
            extracted["q"][0] is None or extracted["k"][0] is None or extracted["v"][0] is None
        ):
            weight = src.c_attn.weight.data
            bias = getattr(src.c_attn, "bias", None)
            bias_data = bias.data if bias is not None else None
            if weight.dim() == 2 and weight.shape[1] == 3 * self.hidden_size:
                weight = weight.t().contiguous()
            split_size = weight.shape[0] // 3
            q_w = weight[:split_size, :]
            k_w = weight[split_size : 2 * split_size, :]
            v_w = weight[2 * split_size :, :]
            q_b = bias_data[:split_size] if bias_data is not None else None
            k_b = bias_data[split_size : 2 * split_size] if bias_data is not None else None
            v_b = bias_data[2 * split_size :] if bias_data is not None else None
            extracted["q"] = (q_w, q_b)
            extracted["k"] = (k_w, k_b)
            extracted["v"] = (v_w, v_b)

        if hasattr(src, "c_proj") and extracted["o"][0] is None:
            w_o = src.c_proj.weight.data
            if (
                w_o.dim() == 2
                and w_o.shape[0] != self.hidden_size
                and w_o.shape[1] == self.hidden_size
            ):
                w_o = w_o.t().contiguous()
            b_o = getattr(src.c_proj, "bias", None)
            extracted["o"] = (w_o, b_o.data if b_o is not None else None)

        # 3. RoBERTa / BERT Nested Encoder handling
        if hasattr(src, "self") and (
            extracted["q"][0] is None or extracted["k"][0] is None or extracted["v"][0] is None
        ):
            s = src.self
            if hasattr(s, "query"):
                extracted["q"] = (s.query.weight.data, getattr(s.query, "bias", None))
            if hasattr(s, "key"):
                extracted["k"] = (s.key.weight.data, getattr(s.key, "bias", None))
            if hasattr(s, "value"):
                extracted["v"] = (s.value.weight.data, getattr(s.value, "bias", None))

        if hasattr(src, "output") and hasattr(src.output, "dense") and extracted["o"][0] is None:
            dense = src.output.dense
            extracted["o"] = (dense.weight.data, getattr(dense, "bias", None))

        # 4. Modern Decoders (Qwen3.5, LLaMA, Mistral) & DistilBERT
        named_map = {
            "q": ["q_proj", "q_lin", "query"],
            "k": ["k_proj", "k_lin", "key"],
            "v": ["v_proj", "v_lin", "value"],
            "o": ["o_proj", "out_proj", "out_lin", "dense"],
        }
        for proj, names in named_map.items():
            if extracted[proj][0] is None:
                for name in names:
                    if hasattr(src, name):
                        layer = getattr(src, name)
                        if hasattr(layer, "weight"):
                            extracted[proj] = (
                                layer.weight.data,
                                getattr(layer, "bias", None),
                            )
                            break

        # Detect nested encoder architecture
        cls_name = src.__class__.__name__
        has_out_proj = any(
            hasattr(src, attr)
            for attr in (
                "dense",
                "out_proj",
                "c_proj",
                "out_lin",
                "o_proj",
                "wo",
                "o",
                "proj",
            )
        )
        # Check output projection attrs FIRST — DistilBERT has out_lin and is NOT nested
        if hasattr(src, "out_lin") or hasattr(src, "c_proj") or hasattr(src, "o_proj"):
            self.is_nested_encoder = False
        elif (
            (
                hasattr(src, "self")
                and hasattr(src.self, "query")
                and hasattr(src, "output")
                and hasattr(src.output, "dense")
            )
            or (
                cls_name in ("BertSelfAttention", "RobertaSelfAttention")
                or (cls_name.endswith("SelfAttention") and not has_out_proj)
            )
            and not has_out_proj
        ):
            self.is_nested_encoder = True
        else:
            self.is_nested_encoder = False

        # Check required weights
        missing = [k for k in ["q", "k", "v"] if extracted[k][0] is None]
        if not self.is_nested_encoder and extracted["o"][0] is None:
            missing.append("o")
        if missing:
            logger.warning(
                f"CompressedAttentionLayer: missing weights for projections {missing}; proceeding with random init"
            )

        # Frobenius norm validation
        for proj_key in ["q", "k", "v"]:
            w = extracted[proj_key][0]
            if w is not None:
                norm = torch.linalg.norm(w.float())
                if norm < 1e-4:
                    logger.warning(
                        f"CompressedAttentionLayer: extracted weight for {proj_key} has near-zero Frobenius norm ({norm.item():.6f}); continuing"
                    )

        if extracted["o"][0] is not None:
            norm_o = torch.linalg.norm(extracted["o"][0].float())
            if norm_o < 1e-4:
                logger.warning(
                    f"CompressedAttentionLayer: extracted weight for output projection has near-zero Frobenius norm ({norm_o.item():.6f}); continuing"
                )

        # Joint SVD on Q, K, V
        def _orient(w: torch.Tensor, in_dim: int) -> torch.Tensor:
            if w.dim() == 2 and w.shape[1] != in_dim and w.shape[0] == in_dim:
                return w.t().contiguous()
            return w

        with torch.no_grad():
            w_q = _orient(extracted["q"][0].float(), self.hidden_size)
            w_k = _orient(extracted["k"][0].float(), self.hidden_size)
            w_v = _orient(extracted["v"][0].float(), self.hidden_size)
            w_qkv = torch.cat([w_q, w_k, w_v], dim=0)

            U, S, Vh = torch.linalg.svd(w_qkv, full_matrices=False)
            r_qkv = min(self.rank_qkv, U.size(1), Vh.size(0))
            sqrt_s = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(S[:r_qkv], min=1e-12))

            qkv_out_dim = self.all_head_size + 2 * self.kv_head_size
            self.U_qkv.data[: min(qkv_out_dim, U.size(0)), :r_qkv].copy_(
                U[: min(qkv_out_dim, U.size(0)), :r_qkv]
            )
            self.S_qkv_sqrt.data[:r_qkv].copy_(sqrt_s)
            self.Vh_qkv.data[:r_qkv, : min(self.hidden_size, Vh.size(1))].copy_(
                Vh[:r_qkv, : min(self.hidden_size, Vh.size(1))]
            )

            b_q = (
                extracted["q"][1]
                if extracted["q"][1] is not None
                else torch.zeros(w_q.size(0), device=w_q.device)
            )
            b_k = (
                extracted["k"][1]
                if extracted["k"][1] is not None
                else torch.zeros(w_k.size(0), device=w_k.device)
            )
            b_v = (
                extracted["v"][1]
                if extracted["v"][1] is not None
                else torch.zeros(w_v.size(0), device=w_v.device)
            )
            b_q_val = b_q.data if isinstance(b_q, nn.Parameter) else b_q
            b_k_val = b_k.data if isinstance(b_k, nn.Parameter) else b_k
            b_v_val = b_v.data if isinstance(b_v, nn.Parameter) else b_v
            b_qkv = torch.cat([b_q_val, b_k_val, b_v_val], dim=0)
            self.bias_qkv.data[: min(qkv_out_dim, b_qkv.size(0))].copy_(
                b_qkv[: min(qkv_out_dim, b_qkv.size(0))]
            )

            # Output projection SVD
            if extracted["o"][0] is not None:
                w_o = _orient(extracted["o"][0].float(), self.all_head_size)
                U_o, S_o, Vh_o = torch.linalg.svd(w_o, full_matrices=False)
                r_out = min(self.rank_out, U_o.size(1), Vh_o.size(0))
                sqrt_so = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(S_o[:r_out], min=1e-12))

                self.U_out.data[: min(self.hidden_size, U_o.size(0)), :r_out].copy_(
                    U_o[: min(self.hidden_size, U_o.size(0)), :r_out]
                )
                self.S_out_sqrt.data[:r_out].copy_(sqrt_so)
                self.Vh_out.data[:r_out, : min(self.all_head_size, Vh_o.size(1))].copy_(
                    Vh_o[:r_out, : min(self.all_head_size, Vh_o.size(1))]
                )

                if extracted["o"][1] is not None:
                    b_o = extracted["o"][1]
                    b_o_data = b_o.data if isinstance(b_o, nn.Parameter) else b_o
                    self.bias_out.data[: min(self.hidden_size, b_o_data.size(0))].copy_(
                        b_o_data[: min(self.hidden_size, b_o_data.size(0))]
                    )
            elif self.is_nested_encoder:
                self.U_out.data.zero_()
                min_d = min(self.hidden_size, self.rank_out)
                self.U_out.data[:min_d, :min_d].fill_diagonal_(1.0)
                self.S_out_sqrt.data.fill_(1.0)
                self.Vh_out.data.zero_()
                self.Vh_out.data[:min_d, :min_d].fill_diagonal_(1.0)
                self.bias_out.data.zero_()

            # Ensure base weights are frozen
            self.Vh_qkv.requires_grad = False
            self.S_qkv_sqrt.requires_grad = False
            self.U_qkv.requires_grad = False
            self.bias_qkv.requires_grad = False
            self.Vh_out.requires_grad = False
            self.S_out_sqrt.requires_grad = False
            self.U_out.requires_grad = False
            self.bias_out.requires_grad = False

            if self.lora_rank > 0:
                self.reset_lora_parameters()

        if hasattr(src, "is_decoder"):
            self.is_decoder = bool(src.is_decoder)

    def forward(
        self,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        head_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        encoder_hidden_states: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        encoder_attention_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        past_key_value: Any | None = None,
        output_attentions: bool | None = False,
        output_hidden_states: bool | None = False,
        return_dict: bool | None = True,
        *args: Any,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
        if hidden_states.dim() == 2:
            hidden_states = hidden_states.unsqueeze(0)
        B, N, D = hidden_states.shape
        device = hidden_states.device
        dtype = hidden_states.dtype

        # FIX 1: Pre-transpose weight matrices to avoid runtime transposes
        # Vh_qkv is (Rank, D), U_qkv is (Out_Dim, Rank)
        # S_qkv_sqrt is (Rank)

        # Optimize Matmul path
        v_proj = torch.matmul(hidden_states, self.Vh_qkv.t()) * self.S_qkv_sqrt
        qkv = torch.matmul(v_proj, (self.U_qkv * self.S_qkv_sqrt).t()) + self.bias_qkv

        # LoRA residual adapter
        if self.lora_rank > 0 and self.lora_A_qkv is not None and self.lora_B_qkv is not None:
            lora_qkv = (
                F.linear(F.linear(hidden_states, self.lora_A_qkv), self.lora_B_qkv)
                * self.lora_scaling
            )
            qkv = qkv + lora_qkv

        # Split into Q, K, V
        q, k, v = torch.split(
            qkv, [self.all_head_size, self.kv_head_size, self.kv_head_size], dim=-1
        )

        # FIX 2: Remove .contiguous() memory bombs
        q = q.view(B, N, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        k = k.view(B, N, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.view(B, N, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)

        # Apply RoPE
        position_embeddings = kwargs.get("position_embeddings")
        if (
            position_embeddings is not None
            and isinstance(position_embeddings, (tuple, list))
            and len(position_embeddings) >= 2
        ):
            cos, sin = position_embeddings[0], position_embeddings[1]
            q, k = apply_rotary_pos_emb(q, k, cos, sin, kwargs.get("position_ids"))

        # GQA repeat
        if self.kv_repeat > 1:
            k = repeat_kv(k, self.kv_repeat)
            v = repeat_kv(v, self.kv_repeat)

        scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(self.head_dim)

        # Use torch.baddbmm or scaled_dot_product_attention for huge memory savings
        # Fallback to standard matmul if not available or unsupported shapes
        try:
            # PyTorch 2.0+ Flash Attention / Memory Efficient Attention
            # This handles Causal masking automatically and saves massive VRAM
            is_causal = self.is_decoder and (attention_mask is None or attention_mask.dim() != 4)
            attn_out = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
                q,
                k,
                v,
                attn_mask=attention_mask,
                dropout_p=self.dropout.p if self.training else 0.0,
                is_causal=is_causal,
            )
            probs = None  # SDPA doesn't return probabilities to save memory
        except Exception:
            # Legacy Path (if SDPA fails due to old PyTorch or weird masks)
            scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)) * scale

            mask = attention_mask if attention_mask is not None else kwargs.get("mask")
            if mask is not None:
                if mask.dim() == 4:
                    if mask.dtype == torch.bool:
                        scores = scores.masked_fill(~mask, -10000.0)
                    else:
                        scores = scores + mask.to(scores.dtype)
                else:
                    valid_m = get_token_valid_mask(mask, B, N, device)
                    if valid_m is not None:
                        scores = scores.masked_fill((~valid_m).unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2), -10000.0)

            # Explicit Causal Masking
            if self.is_decoder and (mask is None or mask.dim() != 4):
                causal_tril = (
                    torch.tril(torch.ones((N, N), device=device, dtype=torch.bool))
                    .unsqueeze(0)
                    .unsqueeze(0)
                )
                scores = scores.masked_fill(~causal_tril, -10000.0)

            # FIX 3: Safe Softmax without extra type casts that create new tensors
            probs = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(dtype)
            probs = self.dropout(probs)
            attn_out = torch.matmul(probs, v)

        # Transpose back and view (reshape handles non-contiguous memory safely without deep copies)
        attn_out = attn_out.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, self.all_head_size)

        if self.is_nested_encoder:
            out = attn_out
        else:
            # SVD Out forward
            out_v = torch.matmul(attn_out, self.Vh_out.t()) * self.S_out_sqrt
            out = torch.matmul(out_v, (self.U_out * self.S_out_sqrt).t()) + self.bias_out
            if self.lora_rank > 0 and self.lora_A_out is not None and self.lora_B_out is not None:
                lora_out = (
                    F.linear(F.linear(attn_out, self.lora_A_out), self.lora_B_out)
                    * self.lora_scaling
                )
                out = out + lora_out

        return out, (probs if output_attentions and probs is not None else None)

        nn.init.zeros_(self.lora_B_qkv)

class CompressionPlanningTokens:
    """
    Static CPT heuristic importance generator.
    Serves as safe baseline fallback when learnable CPT generator is inactive.
    """

    TASK_KEYWORD_MAP = {
        "qa": [
            "question",
            "answer",
            "context",
            "passage",
            "who",
            "what",
            "where",
            "why",
        ],
        "summarize": ["summary", "abstract", "key", "main", "brief", "conclusion"],
        "code": [
            "function",
            "class",
            "def",
            "return",
            "import",
            "self",
            "error",
            "test",
        ],
        "reasoning": [
            "therefore",
            "because",
            "if",
            "then",
            "thus",
            "proof",
            "step",
            "hence",
        ],
        "math": [
            "solve",
            "equation",
            "matrix",
            "integral",
            "theorem",
            "calculate",
            "equal",
        ],
    }

    @classmethod
    def generate_importance(
        cls,
        task_type: str,
        num_features: int,
        device: torch.device = torch.device("cpu"),
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Generate per-feature importance modulation vector based on static heuristics."""
        task_lower = str(task_type).lower()
        importance = torch.zeros(num_features, device=device)

        # Baseline structure: prompt position bias
        pos_dim = max(1, num_features // 4)
        importance[:pos_dim] = 0.25

        if any(kw in task_lower for kw in ["qa", "question"]):
            importance[pos_dim : 2 * pos_dim] += 0.35
        elif any(kw in task_lower for kw in ["code", "program"]):
            importance[2 * pos_dim : 3 * pos_dim] += 0.40
        elif any(kw in task_lower for kw in ["reason", "math"]):
            importance += 0.20

        return torch.clamp(importance + 0.5, min=0.1, max=2.0)

class Conv1D (nf, nx)
Expand source code 
class Conv1D(nn.Module):
    """
    1D-convolutional layer as defined by Radford et al. for OpenAI GPT (and also used in GPT-2).

    Basically works like a linear layer but the weights are transposed.

    Args:
        nf (`int`): The number of output features.
        nx (`int`): The number of input features.
    """

    def __init__(self, nf, nx):
        super().__init__()
        self.nf = nf
        self.nx = nx
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(nx, nf))
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(nf))
        nn.init.normal_(self.weight, std=0.02)

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return "Conv1D(nf={nf}, nx={nx})".format(**self.__dict__)

    def forward(self, x):
        size_out = x.size()[:-1] + (self.nf,)
        x = torch.addmm(self.bias, x.view(-1, x.size(-1)), self.weight)
        x = x.view(size_out)
        return x

class CoopQLinear(nn.Module):
    """
    CoopQ Linear layer with per-channel asymmetric quantization and STE backpropagation.
    Supports both standard nn.Linear and Conv1D weight representations.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        in_features: int,
        out_features: int,
        bias: bool = True,
        bits: int = 4,
        symmetric: bool = False,
        per_channel: bool = True,
        lora_r: int = 0,
        lora_alpha: float = 1.0,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.in_features = in_features
        self.out_features = out_features
        self.nf = out_features  # Conv1D compatibility
        self.bits = max(4, int(bits))
        self.symmetric = symmetric
        self.per_channel = per_channel
        self.lora_r = int(lora_r)
        self.lora_alpha = float(lora_alpha)
        self.scaling = (self.lora_alpha / self.lora_r) if self.lora_r > 0 else 1.0

        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(out_features, in_features))
        if bias:
            self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(out_features))
        else:
            self.register_parameter("bias", None)

        if self.lora_r > 0:
            self.lora_A = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(self.lora_r, in_features))
            self.lora_B = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(out_features, self.lora_r))
            nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.lora_A, a=math.sqrt(5))
            nn.init.zeros_(self.lora_B)
        else:
            self.register_parameter("lora_A", None)
            self.register_parameter("lora_B", None)

        nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.weight, a=5**0.5)
        if self.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(self.bias)

    @classmethod
    def from_linear(
        cls,
        linear: nn.Module,
        bits: int = 4,
        symmetric: bool = False,
        per_channel: bool = True,
        lora_r: int = 0,
        lora_alpha: float = 1.0,
    ) -> CoopQLinear:
        cls_name = linear.__class__.__name__.lower()
        is_conv1d = "conv1d" in cls_name or hasattr(linear, "nf")
        raw_w = linear.weight.data

        if is_conv1d:
            in_f = raw_w.shape[0]
            out_f = raw_w.shape[1]
            w_data = raw_w.t().contiguous()
        else:
            out_f = raw_w.shape[0]
            in_f = raw_w.shape[1]
            w_data = raw_w.contiguous()

        layer = cls(
            in_features=in_f,
            out_features=out_f,
            bias=getattr(linear, "bias", None) is not None and linear.bias is not None,
            bits=bits,
            symmetric=symmetric,
            per_channel=per_channel,
            lora_r=lora_r,
            lora_alpha=lora_alpha,
        )
        layer.weight.data.copy_(w_data)
        if getattr(linear, "bias", None) is not None and linear.bias is not None:
            layer.bias.data.copy_(linear.bias.data)
        return layer

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        w_q = quantize_dequantize_coopq(
            self.weight,
            bits=self.bits,
            symmetric=self.symmetric,
            per_channel=self.per_channel,
            use_ste=self.training,
        )
        b_q = None
        if self.bias is not None:
            b_q = quantize_dequantize_coopq(
                self.bias,
                bits=self.bits,
                symmetric=self.symmetric,
                per_channel=False,
                use_ste=self.training,
            )
        out = F.linear(
            x,
            w_q.to(dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device),
            b_q.to(dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device) if b_q is not None else None,
        )
        if self.lora_r > 0 and self.lora_A is not None and self.lora_B is not None:
            lora_out = F.linear(F.linear(x, self.lora_A), self.lora_B)
            out = out + (self.scaling * lora_out).to(out.dtype)
        return out

class CoopQQuantizer(BaseCompressor):
    """
    CoopQ: Cooperative Game-Theoretic Bit Allocation Quantization.
    Allocates discrete bit-widths (>= 4 bits) across transformer layers
    proportional to layer sensitivity (Frobenius energy / variance), guaranteeing
    a target mean bit-budget under strict distortion minimization.

    Args:
        model: PyTorch model.
        bits: Target average bit-width (default 4).
        min_bits: Minimum allowable bit-width per layer (floor enforced at >= 4).
        max_bits: Maximum allowable bit-width per layer (default 8).
        symmetric: Whether to use symmetric quantization (default False for asymmetric calibration).
        per_channel: Whether to use per-channel scale factors (default True).
        use_ste: Whether to substitute nn.Linear with CoopQLinear for QAT (default True).
        target_attention_only: If True, only quantize attention projection layers (skip FFN/MLP).
        cfg: Optional configuration dictionary, namespace, or object.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: nn.Module,
        bits: int = 4,
        min_bits: int = 4,
        max_bits: int = 8,
        symmetric: bool = False,
        per_channel: bool = True,
        use_ste: bool = True,
        recalibrate_ln: bool = True,
        target_attention_only: bool = False,
        tokenizer: Any | None = None,
        calibration_loader: Any | None = None,
        calibration_texts: list[str] | None = None,
        device: str | torch.device | None = None,
        cfg: Any | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(model, name="coopq", **kwargs)
        # Extract config values with _cfg_get fallbacks
        c_bits = _cfg_get(cfg, "coopq_bits", _cfg_get(cfg, "bits", bits))
        c_min_bits = _cfg_get(cfg, "coopq_min_bits", _cfg_get(cfg, "min_bits", min_bits))
        c_max_bits = _cfg_get(cfg, "coopq_max_bits", _cfg_get(cfg, "max_bits", max_bits))
        c_symmetric = _cfg_get(cfg, "coopq_symmetric", _cfg_get(cfg, "symmetric", symmetric))
        c_per_channel = _cfg_get(
            cfg, "coopq_per_channel", _cfg_get(cfg, "per_channel", per_channel)
        )
        c_use_ste = _cfg_get(cfg, "coopq_use_ste", _cfg_get(cfg, "use_ste", use_ste))
        c_recalibrate_ln = _cfg_get(
            cfg, "coopq_recalibrate_ln", _cfg_get(cfg, "recalibrate_ln", recalibrate_ln)
        )
        c_target_attn = _cfg_get(
            cfg,
            "coopq_target_attention_only",
            _cfg_get(cfg, "target_attention_only", target_attention_only),
        )

        self.min_bits = max(4, int(c_min_bits))
        self.max_bits = max(self.min_bits, int(c_max_bits))
        self.bits = max(self.min_bits, min(int(c_bits), self.max_bits))
        self.symmetric = bool(c_symmetric)
        self.per_channel = bool(c_per_channel)
        self.use_ste = bool(c_use_ste)
        self.recalibrate_ln = bool(c_recalibrate_ln)
        self.target_attention_only = bool(c_target_attn)

        self.tokenizer = tokenizer or getattr(model, "tokenizer", None)
        self.calibration_loader = calibration_loader
        self.calibration_texts = calibration_texts
        self.target_device = (
            torch.device(device)
            if device is not None
            else (next(model.parameters(), torch.tensor(0.0)).device)
        )
        self.stats: dict[str, Any] = {}

    def _is_target_module(self, name: str, module: nn.Module) -> bool:
        """Identify candidate linear/Conv1D/LoRALinear modules."""
        cls_name = module.__class__.__name__.lower()
        has_base = hasattr(module, "base_layer")
        base_cls = module.base_layer.__class__.__name__.lower() if has_base else ""

        is_linear = isinstance(module, nn.Linear) or "linear" in cls_name
        is_conv1d = "conv1d" in cls_name or hasattr(module, "nf")
        is_lora = has_base and (
            isinstance(module.base_layer, nn.Linear)
            or "conv1d" in base_cls
            or hasattr(module.base_layer, "nf")
        )

        if not (is_linear or is_conv1d or is_lora):
            return False

        if isinstance(module, CoopQLinear) or (
            has_base and isinstance(module.base_layer, CoopQLinear)
        ):
            return False

        name_lower = name.lower()
        if any(
            skip in name_lower
            for skip in [
                "classifier",
                "score",
                "lm_head",
                "pooler",
                "embed",
                "logits_processor",
                "pre_classifier",
                "head",
            ]
        ):
            return False

        if self.target_attention_only:
            ffn_patterns = [
                "ffn",
                "mlp",
                "lin1",
                "lin2",
                "intermediate",
                "gate_proj",
                "up_proj",
                "down_proj",
                "c_fc",
            ]
            if any(p in name_lower for p in ffn_patterns):
                return False
            if "output.dense" in name_lower and "attention" not in name_lower:
                return False
            attn_patterns = [
                "attn",
                "attention",
                "q_proj",
                "k_proj",
                "v_proj",
                "o_proj",
                "out_lin",
                "q_lin",
                "k_lin",
                "v_lin",
                "c_attn",
                "c_proj",
                "query",
                "key",
                "value",
                "in_proj_qkv",
                "out_proj",
            ]
            if not any(p in name_lower for p in attn_patterns):
                return False

        return True

    def _calculate_layer_sensitivities(self) -> dict[str, float]:
        """Compute sensitivity metric per target layer based on normalized Frobenius energy and variance."""
        sensitivities: dict[str, float] = {}
        for name, module in self.model.named_modules():
            if self._is_target_module(name, module):
                target_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", getattr(module, "linear", module))
                raw_w = target_mod.weight.data
                cls_name = module.__class__.__name__.lower()
                is_conv1d = (
                    "conv1d" in cls_name or hasattr(module, "nf") or hasattr(target_mod, "nf")
                )
                W = raw_w.t().float() if is_conv1d else raw_w.float()
                frob_norm = torch.norm(W, p="fro").item() / (W.numel() ** 0.5 + 1e-8)
                std_val = torch.std(W).item() if W.numel() > 1 else 0.0
                sensitivities[name] = float(frob_norm + std_val)
        return sensitivities

    def _allocate_bits(self, sensitivities: dict[str, float]) -> dict[str, int]:
        """Allocate discrete integer bit-widths satisfying mean(bits) <= self.bits with floor >= min_bits (>= 4)."""
        if not sensitivities:
            return {}

        total_sens = sum(sensitivities.values()) + 1e-8
        num_layers = len(sensitivities)
        target_total_bits = self.bits * num_layers

        # Allowed bit-levels with floor >= self.min_bits (>= 4)
        allowed_bits = [b for b in [4, 5, 6, 7, 8] if self.min_bits <= b <= self.max_bits]
        if not allowed_bits:
            allowed_bits = [self.min_bits]

        # Continuous allocation proportional to sensitivity
        raw_allocations: dict[str, float] = {}
        mean_sens = total_sens / num_layers
        for name, sens in sensitivities.items():
            sens_ratio = sens / mean_sens
            raw_bits = self.bits + (sens_ratio - 1.0) * (self.max_bits - self.min_bits) / 2.0
            raw_allocations[name] = max(float(self.min_bits), min(float(self.max_bits), raw_bits))

        discrete_allocations: dict[str, int] = {}
        for name, raw_b in raw_allocations.items():
            closest_b = min(allowed_bits, key=lambda b: abs(b - raw_b))
            discrete_allocations[name] = closest_b

        # Adjust sum to match target total bits budget
        current_sum = sum(discrete_allocations.values())
        sorted_names = sorted(sensitivities.keys(), key=lambda k: sensitivities[k], reverse=True)

        if current_sum > target_total_bits:
            for name in reversed(sorted_names):
                curr_b = discrete_allocations[name]
                valid_lower = [b for b in allowed_bits if b < curr_b]
                if valid_lower:
                    discrete_allocations[name] = max(valid_lower)
                    current_sum = sum(discrete_allocations.values())
                    if current_sum <= target_total_bits:
                        break
        elif current_sum < target_total_bits:
            for name in sorted_names:
                curr_b = discrete_allocations[name]
                valid_higher = [b for b in allowed_bits if b > curr_b]
                if valid_higher:
                    discrete_allocations[name] = min(valid_higher)
                    current_sum = sum(discrete_allocations.values())
                    if current_sum >= target_total_bits:
                        break

        # Ensure strict min_bits floor on all layers
        for k in discrete_allocations:
            discrete_allocations[k] = max(self.min_bits, discrete_allocations[k])

        return discrete_allocations

    def compress(self) -> tuple[nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
        """Quantize linear layers with layer-specific bit allocation (>= 4 bits) and per-channel asymmetric calibration."""
        sensitivities = self._calculate_layer_sensitivities()
        bit_allocations = self._allocate_bits(sensitivities)

        total_bits_weighted = 0
        total_params_linear = 0
        compressed_layers = []
        fallback_layers = []

        for name, module in list(self.model.named_modules()):
            if not self._is_target_module(name, module):
                # When target_attention_only is True, unselected FFN/MLP layers must be frozen during fine-tuning
                if self.target_attention_only:
                    is_lin_like = (
                        isinstance(module, nn.Linear)
                        or "conv1d" in module.__class__.__name__.lower()
                        or hasattr(module, "base_layer")
                    )
                    if is_lin_like:
                        for p in module.parameters():
                            p.requires_grad = False
                continue

            if name not in bit_allocations:
                continue

            target_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", getattr(module, "linear", module))
            cls_name = module.__class__.__name__.lower()
            is_conv1d = "conv1d" in cls_name or hasattr(module, "nf") or hasattr(target_mod, "nf")
            has_lora = (hasattr(module, "lora_A") and module.lora_A is not None) or hasattr(
                module, "base_layer"
            )

            layer_bits = bit_allocations[name]
            num_params = target_mod.weight.numel()
            total_bits_weighted += layer_bits * num_params
            total_params_linear += num_params

            if self.use_ste:
                src_lora_r = 0
                src_lora_alpha = 1.0
                if (
                    hasattr(module, "lora_A")
                    and hasattr(module, "lora_B")
                    and module.lora_A is not None
                    and module.lora_B is not None
                ):
                    src_lA = getattr(module.lora_A, "weight", module.lora_A)
                    if hasattr(src_lA, "shape") and len(src_lA.shape) == 2:
                        src_lora_r = src_lA.shape[0]
                    src_lora_alpha = getattr(module, "lora_alpha", float(src_lora_r))

                coopq_layer = CoopQLinear.from_linear(
                    target_mod,
                    bits=layer_bits,
                    symmetric=self.symmetric,
                    per_channel=self.per_channel,
                    lora_r=src_lora_r,
                    lora_alpha=src_lora_alpha,
                )
                new_layer = coopq_layer
                compressed_layer = new_layer
                # Preserve existing LoRA adapter weights if the source module has them
                if (
                    hasattr(module, "lora_A")
                    and hasattr(module, "lora_B")
                    and module.lora_A is not None
                    and module.lora_B is not None
                ):
                    src_lA = getattr(module.lora_A, "weight", module.lora_A)
                    src_lB = getattr(module.lora_B, "weight", module.lora_B)
                    if hasattr(new_layer, "lora_A") and new_layer.lora_A is not None:
                        if hasattr(src_lA, "data") and src_lA.shape == new_layer.lora_A.shape:
                            new_layer.lora_A.data.copy_(src_lA.data)
                    if hasattr(new_layer, "lora_B") and new_layer.lora_B is not None:
                        if hasattr(src_lB, "data") and src_lB.shape == new_layer.lora_B.shape:
                            new_layer.lora_B.data.copy_(src_lB.data)

                if hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                    module.base_layer = compressed_layer  # put compressed layer inside wrapper
                    # module itself (LoRALinear wrapper) remains the replacement
                    new_module = module
                else:
                    new_module = compressed_layer

                if not hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                    if name == "":
                        self.model = new_module
                    else:
                        replace_module(self.model, name, new_module)
            else:
                raw_w = target_mod.weight.data
                W = raw_w.t().float() if is_conv1d else raw_w.float()
                W_quant = quantize_dequantize_coopq(
                    W,
                    bits=layer_bits,
                    symmetric=self.symmetric,
                    per_channel=self.per_channel,
                    use_ste=False,
                )
                if is_conv1d:
                    target_mod.weight.data.copy_(
                        W_quant.t().contiguous().to(dtype=raw_w.dtype, device=raw_w.device)
                    )
                else:
                    target_mod.weight.data.copy_(
                        W_quant.contiguous().to(dtype=raw_w.dtype, device=raw_w.device)
                    )

                if target_mod.bias is not None:
                    b_quant = quantize_dequantize_coopq(
                        target_mod.bias.data.float(),
                        bits=layer_bits,
                        symmetric=self.symmetric,
                        per_channel=False,
                        use_ste=False,
                    )
                    target_mod.bias.data.copy_(
                        b_quant.to(dtype=target_mod.bias.dtype, device=target_mod.bias.device)
                    )

            # Preserve pre-existing LoRA adapter parameters and trainability
            if has_lora:
                for p_name, p in module.named_parameters():
                    if any(t in p_name.lower() for t in ("lora_a", "lora_b", "adapter")):
                        p.requires_grad = True

            compressed_layers.append(name)

        # LayerNorm Recalibration
        if self.recalibrate_ln:
            recalibrate_layernorms(
                self.model,
                tokenizer=self.tokenizer,
                calibration_loader=self.calibration_loader,
                calibration_texts=self.calibration_texts,
                device=self.target_device,
            )

        avg_bits = (
            total_bits_weighted / total_params_linear
            if total_params_linear > 0
            else float(self.bits)
        )
        effective_compression_rate = 16.0 / max(avg_bits, 1e-3)
        stats = self.get_compression_stats()
        stats.update(
            {
                "target_bits": self.bits,
                "min_bits_floor": self.min_bits,
                "average_allocated_bits": round(avg_bits, 2),
                "layer_bit_allocations": bit_allocations,
                "compressed_layers": compressed_layers,
                "compressed_layer_count": len(compressed_layers),
                "fallback_layers": fallback_layers,
                "fallback_layer_count": len(fallback_layers),
                "symmetric": self.symmetric,
                "per_channel": self.per_channel,
                "use_ste": self.use_ste,
                "target_attention_only": self.target_attention_only,
                "effective_compression_rate": round(effective_compression_rate, 2),
                "recalibrate_ln": self.recalibrate_ln,
                "method": "coopq_asymmetric_ste_bmin4",
                "theoretical_vram_saving": f"{(1.0 - avg_bits / 16.0) * 100:.1f}% vs FP16",
            }
        )
        self.stats = stats
        return self.model, stats

CoopQ: Cooperative Game-Theoretic Bit Allocation Quantization. Allocates discrete bit-widths (>= 4 bits) across transformer layers proportional to layer sensitivity (Frobenius energy / variance), guaranteeing a target mean bit-budget under strict distortion minimization.

Args
-----=
model
PyTorch model.
bits
Target average bit-width (default 4).
min_bits
Minimum allowable bit-width per layer (floor enforced at >= 4).
max_bits
Maximum allowable bit-width per layer (default 8).
symmetric
Whether to use symmetric quantization (default False for asymmetric calibration).
per_channel
Whether to use per-channel scale factors (default True).
use_ste
Whether to substitute nn.Linear with CoopQLinear for QAT (default True).
target_attention_only
If True, only quantize attention projection layers (skip FFN/MLP).
cfg
Optional configuration dictionary, namespace, or object.

class CoopQSTEFakeQuantize (*args, **kwargs)
Expand source code 
class CoopQSTEFakeQuantize(torch.autograd.Function):
    """
    Straight-Through Estimator (STE) fake-quantization autograd function for CoopQ.
    Forwards per-channel quantized-dequantized weights and passes gradients through on backward pass.
    """

    @staticmethod
    def forward(
        ctx: Any,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        scale: torch.Tensor,
        zero_point: torch.Tensor,
        qmin: float,
        qmax: float,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        ctx.save_for_backward(scale, zero_point)
        ctx.qmin = qmin
        ctx.qmax = qmax

        # Quantize and clamp
        q = torch.clamp(torch.round(x / scale) + zero_point, qmin, qmax)
        # De-quantize
        dq = (q - zero_point) * scale
        return dq

    @staticmethod
    def backward(
        ctx: Any, grad_output: torch.Tensor
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, None, None, None, None]:
        # STE passes gradient uninhibited to parameter tensor
        grad_x = grad_output.clone()
        return grad_x, None, None, None, None

Define a formula for differentiating the operation with backward mode automatic differentiation.

This function is to be overridden by all subclasses. (Defining this function is equivalent to defining the vjp function.)

It must accept a context :attr:ctx as the first argument, followed by as many outputs as the :func:forward returned (None will be passed in for non tensor outputs of the forward function), and it should return as many tensors, as there were inputs to :func:forward. Each argument is the gradient w.r.t the given output, and each returned value should be the gradient w.r.t. the corresponding input. If an input is not a Tensor or is a Tensor not requiring grads, you can just pass None as a gradient for that input.

The context can be used to retrieve tensors saved during the forward pass. It also has an attribute :attr:ctx.needs_input_grad as a tuple of booleans representing whether each input needs gradient. E.g., :func:backward will have ctx.needs_input_grad[0] = True if the first input to :func:forward needs gradient computed w.r.t. the output.

Define the forward of the custom autograd Function.

This function is to be overridden by all subclasses. There are two ways to define forward:

Usage 1 (Combined forward and ctx)::

@staticmethod
def forward(ctx: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    pass
  • It must accept a context ctx as the first argument, followed by any number of arguments (tensors or other types).
  • See :ref:combining-forward-context for more details

Usage 2 (Separate forward and ctx)::

@staticmethod
def forward(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    pass


@staticmethod
def setup_context(ctx: Any, inputs: Tuple[Any, ...], output: Any) -> None:
    pass
  • The forward no longer accepts a ctx argument.
  • Instead, you must also override the :meth:torch.autograd.Function.setup_context staticmethod to handle setting up the ctx object. output is the output of the forward, inputs are a Tuple of inputs to the forward.
  • See :ref:extending-autograd for more details

The context can be used to store arbitrary data that can be then retrieved during the backward pass. Tensors should not be stored directly on ctx (though this is not currently enforced for backward compatibility). Instead, tensors should be saved either with :func:ctx.save_for_backward if they are intended to be used in backward (equivalently, vjp) or :func:ctx.save_for_forward if they are intended to be used for in jvp.

Expand source code 
@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("drone")
@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("drone_compressor")
class DRONECompressor(BaseCompressor):
    """
    DRONE Compressor.
    Data-aware SVD with identity weighting (standard data-independent SVD baseline)
    using identical rank adaptation, parameter constraints, and fallback error mechanism as AASVD.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: nn.Module,
        tokenizer: Any | None = None,
        rank: int = 64,
        max_error: float = 0.50,
        fallback_to_original: bool = True,
        device: str | torch.device | None = None,
        target_modules: list[str] | None = None,
        target_attention_only: bool = True,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(model, name="drone", **kwargs)
        cfg = kwargs.get("comp_config", kwargs.get("cfg"))
        if cfg is not None:
            rank = getattr(cfg, "drone_rank", getattr(cfg, "rank", rank))
            max_error = getattr(cfg, "drone_max_error", getattr(cfg, "max_error", max_error))
            fallback_to_original = getattr(
                cfg,
                "drone_fallback_to_original",
                getattr(cfg, "fallback_to_original", fallback_to_original),
            )
            target_attention_only = getattr(
                cfg,
                "drone_target_attention_only",
                getattr(cfg, "target_attention_only", target_attention_only),
            )

        target_attention_only = kwargs.get(
            "target_attention_only",
            kwargs.get("drone_target_attention_only", target_attention_only),
        )
        self.rank = rank
        if max_error is None or max_error == 0.50:
            max_error = adaptive_max_error(self.rank, 768, 768, "distilbert")

        self.max_error = float(max_error)
        self.fallback_to_original = fallback_to_original
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.target_modules = target_modules
        self.target_attention_only = target_attention_only
        self.device = (
            torch.device(device) if device is not None else next(model.parameters()).device
        )
        self.compressed_layers: list[str] = []
        self.fallback_layers: list[str] = []
        self.layer_errors: dict[str, float] = {}
        self.layer_ranks: dict[str, int] = {}

    def _is_target_module(self, name: str, module: nn.Module) -> bool:
        if isinstance(module, SVDLinear):
            return False
        if any(
            name.endswith(sfx) for sfx in [".base_layer", ".lora_A", ".lora_B", ".lora_dropout"]
        ):
            return False

        target_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
        cls_name = module.__class__.__name__.lower()
        target_cls = target_mod.__class__.__name__.lower()

        is_linear_like = (
            isinstance(module, nn.Linear)
            or isinstance(target_mod, nn.Linear)
            or "conv1d" in cls_name
            or "conv1d" in target_cls
            or hasattr(module, "nf")
            or hasattr(target_mod, "nf")
            or "loralinear" in cls_name
            or hasattr(module, "base_layer")
        )
        if not is_linear_like:
            return False
        name_lower = name.lower()
        if any(
            skip in name_lower
            for skip in [
                "lm_head",
                "classifier",
                "head",
                "output_layer",
                "score",
                "pooler",
            ]
        ):
            return False

        if self.target_attention_only:
            ffn_patterns = [
                "ffn",
                "mlp",
                "lin1",
                "lin2",
                "intermediate",
                "gate_proj",
                "up_proj",
                "down_proj",
                "c_fc",
            ]
            if any(p in name_lower for p in ffn_patterns):
                return False
            if "output.dense" in name_lower and "attention" not in name_lower:
                return False
            attn_patterns = [
                "attn",
                "attention",
                "q_proj",
                "k_proj",
                "v_proj",
                "o_proj",
                "out_lin",
                "q_lin",
                "k_lin",
                "v_lin",
                "c_attn",
                "c_proj",
                "query",
                "key",
                "value",
            ]
            if not any(p in name_lower for p in attn_patterns):
                return False
        else:
            if not should_compress_linear(self.model, name):
                return False

        if self.target_modules is not None:
            return any(t in name for t in self.target_modules)
        return True

    def compress_linear(
        self,
        layer: nn.Module,
        rank: int | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[SVDLinear | None, float, int]:
        try:
            target_mod = getattr(layer, "base_layer", layer)
            cls_name = layer.__class__.__name__.lower()
            target_cls = target_mod.__class__.__name__.lower()
            is_conv1d = (
                "conv1d" in cls_name
                or "conv1d" in target_cls
                or hasattr(layer, "nf")
                or hasattr(target_mod, "nf")
            )
            weight_tensor = getattr(target_mod, "weight", getattr(layer, "weight", None))
            if weight_tensor is None:
                return None, float("inf"), 0

            raw_w = weight_tensor.data

            if is_conv1d:
                in_feat, out_feat = raw_w.shape[0], raw_w.shape[1]
                W = raw_w.t().contiguous().float()
            else:
                out_feat, in_feat = raw_w.shape[0], raw_w.shape[1]
                W = raw_w.float()

            r = get_dynamic_compression_rank(
                in_feat,
                out_feat,
                model_or_family=self.model,
                default_rank=rank or self.rank,
                comp_config=getattr(self, "comp_config", None),
            )
            max_allowed_rank = max(
                1,
                min(
                    in_feat,
                    out_feat,
                    int(0.75 * (in_feat * out_feat) / (in_feat + out_feat)),
                ),
            )
            r = min(r, max_allowed_rank)
            W_norm = torch.norm(W, p="fro").item()

            W_dev = W.to(device=layer.weight.device, dtype=torch.float32)
            U, S, Vt = torch.linalg.svd(W_dev, full_matrices=False)

            sqrt_S = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(S[:r], min=1e-12))
            U_r = U[:, :r] * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0)
            V_r = sqrt_S.unsqueeze(1) * Vt[:r, :]

            W_recon = torch.matmul(U_r, V_r)
            err = float(torch.norm(W - W_recon, p="fro").item() / max(W_norm, 1e-12))

            dtype = weight_tensor.dtype
            device = weight_tensor.device
            bias_tensor = getattr(target_mod, "bias", getattr(layer, "bias", None))

            svd_layer = SVDLinear(
                in_features=in_feat,
                out_features=out_feat,
                rank=r,
                bias=bias_tensor is not None,
                dtype=dtype,
                device=device,
                lora_r=getattr(self, "lora_r", 0),
                lora_alpha=getattr(self, "lora_alpha", 1.0),
            )
            svd_layer.set_low_rank_factors(
                U_r.to(device=device, dtype=dtype),
                V_r.to(device=device, dtype=dtype),
            )
            if bias_tensor is not None and svd_layer.bias is not None:
                svd_layer.bias.data.copy_(bias_tensor.data)

            svd_layer.reconstruction_error = err
            svd_layer.rank = r
            return svd_layer, err, r
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("DRONE factorization failed on linear: %s", e)
            return None, float("inf"), 0

    def compress(self) -> tuple[nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
        self.model.eval()
        self.compressed_layers = []
        self.fallback_layers = []
        self.layer_errors = {}
        self.layer_ranks = {}

        for name, module in list(self.model.named_modules()):
            if self._is_target_module(name, module):
                svd_layer, err, r = self.compress_linear(module, rank=self.rank)
                self.layer_errors[name] = err
                self.layer_ranks[name] = r

                if svd_layer is None or err > self.max_error:
                    if self.fallback_to_original:
                        logger.warning(
                            "DRONE reconstruction error %.4f on %s exceeded threshold %.4f. Skipping compression (fallback).",
                            err,
                            name,
                            self.max_error,
                        )
                        self.fallback_layers.append(name)
                        continue
                    else:
                        if svd_layer is None:
                            self.fallback_layers.append(name)
                            continue

                if hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                    module.base_layer = svd_layer
                else:
                    replace_module(self.model, name, svd_layer)
                self.compressed_layers.append(name)

        stats = {
            "compressed_layers": self.compressed_layers,
            "compressed_layer_count": len(self.compressed_layers),
            "fallback_layers": self.fallback_layers,
            "fallback_layer_count": len(self.fallback_layers),
            "num_compressed": len(self.compressed_layers),
            "num_fallback": len(self.fallback_layers),
            "avg_reconstruction_error": (
                float(sum(self.layer_errors.values()) / max(1, len(self.layer_errors)))
                if self.layer_errors
                else 0.0
            ),
            "layer_ranks": self.layer_ranks,
        }
        self.model.compression_stats = stats
        logger.info(
            "Compressor drone finished: %d compressed, %d fallback, avg_err=%.4f, max_err_threshold=%.4f",
            len(self.compressed_layers),
            len(self.fallback_layers),
            stats["avg_reconstruction_error"],
            self.max_error,
        )
        return self.model, stats

DRONE Compressor. Data-aware SVD with identity weighting (standard data-independent SVD baseline) using identical rank adaptation, parameter constraints, and fallback error mechanism as AASVD.

@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("delta_kv_class")
@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("delta_kv_compressor_class")
class DeltaKVCompressor(BaseCompressor):
    # DKV-FIX-01: this is a compressor, not attention.
    is_custom_attention: bool = False

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: nn.Module,
        rank: int = 16,
        sparsity: float = 0.29,
        max_error: float = 0.35,
        target_attention_only: bool = False,
        fallback_to_original: bool = True,
        min_layer_dim: int = 8,
        skip_should_compress_filter: bool = False,
        cfg: Any | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(model, name="delta_kv", **kwargs)
        self.cfg = cfg

        self.rank = int(_cfg_get(cfg, "delta_kv_rank", _cfg_get(cfg, "rank", rank)))
        self.sparsity = float(
            _cfg_get(cfg, "delta_kv_sparsity", _cfg_get(cfg, "sparsity", sparsity))
        )
        self.max_error = float(
            _cfg_get(cfg, "delta_kv_max_error", _cfg_get(cfg, "max_error", max_error))
        )
        self.target_attention_only = bool(
            _cfg_get(
                cfg,
                "delta_kv_target_attention_only",
                _cfg_get(cfg, "target_attention_only", target_attention_only),
            )
        )
        self.fallback_to_original = bool(
            _cfg_get(
                cfg,
                "delta_kv_fallback_to_original",
                _cfg_get(cfg, "fallback_to_original", fallback_to_original),
            )
        )
        self.min_layer_dim = max(1, int(_cfg_get(cfg, "min_layer_dim", min_layer_dim)))
        self.skip_should_compress_filter = bool(
            _cfg_get(
                cfg,
                "skip_should_compress_filter",
                skip_should_compress_filter,
            )
        )

        self.compressed_layers: list[str] = []
        self.fallback_layers: list[str] = []
        self.skipped_layers: list[str] = []
        self.layer_errors: dict[str, float] = {}
        self.layer_ranks: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.stats: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self._compressed_params: int = 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Target check (DKV-FIX-07)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _is_target_module(self, name: str, module: nn.Module, _debug: bool = False) -> bool:
        name_lower = name.lower()
        if any(part in name.split(".") for part in ("lora_A", "lora_B", "base_layer")):
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: lora/base_layer part")
            return False

        # Skip already compressed (DKV-FIX-05 companion)
        cls_name = module.__class__.__name__
        if cls_name in (
            "DeltaKVLinear",
            "LSCPrunedLoRALinear",
            "DynamicSVDLinear",
            "SVDLinear",
            "FactorisedLinear",
        ):
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: already compressed ({cls_name})")
            return False

        if any(
            skip in name_lower
            for skip in [
                "classifier",
                "score",
                "lm_head",
                "pooler",
                "embedding",
                "router",
                "gate",
            ]
        ):
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: skip keyword")
            return False

        target_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
        is_linear = isinstance(target_mod, nn.Linear)
        is_conv1d = _is_conv1d(target_mod)
        if not (is_linear or is_conv1d):
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: not Linear/Conv1D")
            return False

        # DKV-FIX-06: bypass framework filter if requested.
        if not self.skip_should_compress_filter:
            try:
                from neuralops.utils.compat import should_compress_linear

                if not should_compress_linear(self.model, name):
                    if _debug:
                        logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: should_compress_linear=False")
                    return False
            except Exception as e:
                if _debug:
                    logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: should_compress_linear raised {e}")
                return False

        w = getattr(target_mod, "weight", None)
        if w is None:
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: weight None")
            return False
        # DKV-FIX-11: min_layer_dim filter.
        if min(w.shape[0], w.shape[1]) < self.min_layer_dim:
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: dim too small {tuple(w.shape)}")
            return False

        if self.target_attention_only:
            last_part = name.split(".")[-1]
            is_attn = (last_part in _ATTN_NAMES) or any(
                k in name_lower for k in ("attn", "attention")
            )
            if not is_attn:
                if _debug:
                    logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: target_attention_only filter")
                return False

        if _debug:
            logger.info(f"  [TARGET] {name}: shape={tuple(w.shape)}")
        return True

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Main compress
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def compress(self) -> tuple[nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
        # DKV-FIX-09: idempotence
        if getattr(self.model, "_delta_kv_compressed", False):
            logger.warning("DeltaKV: model already compressed; skipping.")
            try:
                stats = self.get_compression_stats()
            except Exception:
                stats = {}
            return self.model, stats

        self.compressed_layers = []
        self.fallback_layers = []
        self.skipped_layers = []
        self.layer_errors = {}
        self.layer_ranks = {}

        total_orig_params = 0
        total_comp_params = 0

        # Diagnostic breakdown if no targets.
        target_list = [
            (name, module)
            for name, module in self.model.named_modules()
            if self._is_target_module(name, module)
        ]
        if not target_list:
            logger.warning("DeltaKV: no compressible layers found. Running diagnostic...")
            n_scanned = 0
            for name, module in self.model.named_modules():
                n_scanned += 1
                self._is_target_module(name, module, _debug=True)
            logger.warning("DeltaKV diagnostic: %d modules scanned, 0 targets.", n_scanned)
            try:
                stats = self.get_compression_stats()
            except Exception:
                stats = {}
            return self.model, stats

        logger.info("DeltaKV: %d target layers identified.", len(target_list))

        # Freeze non-target attention/linear layers when target_attention_only.
        if self.target_attention_only:
            for name, module in self.model.named_modules():
                if any(part in name.split(".") for part in ("lora_A", "lora_B", "base_layer")):
                    continue
                target_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
                if isinstance(target_mod, nn.Linear) or _is_conv1d(target_mod):
                    if not self._is_target_module(name, module):
                        for p in module.parameters():
                            p.requires_grad = False
                        self.skipped_layers.append(name)

        for name, module in target_list:
            target_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
            raw_w = target_mod.weight.data
            is_conv1d = _is_conv1d(target_mod)

            if is_conv1d:
                in_f, out_f = raw_w.shape[0], raw_w.shape[1]
                W = raw_w.t().contiguous().float()
            else:
                out_f, in_f = raw_w.shape[0], raw_w.shape[1]
                W = raw_w.float()

            orig_layer_params = out_f * in_f
            total_orig_params += orig_layer_params
            norm_w = torch.norm(W, p="fro").item()

            try:
                U, S, Vt = torch.linalg.svd(W, full_matrices=False)
                # DKV-FIX-03: correct min over 2D shape.
                r = max(1, min(self.rank, out_f, in_f, len(S)))
                L = (U[:, :r] * S[:r].unsqueeze(0)) @ Vt[:r, :]

                residual = W - L
                flat_r = residual.contiguous().abs().reshape(-1)
                keep_n = max(1, min(int(flat_r.numel() * self.sparsity), flat_r.numel()))
                threshold = torch.topk(flat_r, keep_n).values[-1]
                mask = (residual.abs() >= threshold).float()
                residual_sparse = residual * mask

                W_compressed = L + residual_sparse
                err = float(torch.norm(W - W_compressed, p="fro").item() / max(norm_w, 1e-12))
                self.layer_errors[name] = err
                self.layer_ranks[name] = r

                if err > self.max_error and self.fallback_to_original:
                    logger.warning(
                        "DeltaKV: error %.4f on %s > %.4f; keeping original.",
                        err,
                        name,
                        self.max_error,
                    )
                    self.fallback_layers.append(name)
                    for p in module.parameters():
                        p.requires_grad = False
                    total_comp_params += orig_layer_params
                    continue

                # Write back in original orientation and dtype.
                if is_conv1d:
                    target_mod.weight.data.copy_(
                        W_compressed.t().contiguous().to(dtype=target_mod.weight.dtype)
                    )
                else:
                    target_mod.weight.data.copy_(W_compressed.to(dtype=target_mod.weight.dtype))

                # DKV-FIX-10: requires_grad handled at module level.
                for p in module.parameters():
                    p.requires_grad = True

                self.compressed_layers.append(name)
                # DKV-FIX-12: honest parameter accounting.
                # Note: the dense weight is retained in-place (no reduction);
                # we report the theoretical storage ratio here for reference.
                comp_layer_params = r * (in_f + out_f) + keep_n
                total_comp_params += comp_layer_params

            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning("DeltaKV: decomposition failed on %s: %s", name, e)
                self.fallback_layers.append(name)
                for p in module.parameters():
                    p.requires_grad = False
                total_comp_params += orig_layer_params

        # DKV-FIX-08: forward sanity check.
        forward_check_success = True
        try:
            with torch.no_grad():
                first_p = next(iter(self.model.parameters()), None)
                dev = first_p.device if first_p is not None else torch.device("cpu")
                dummy = torch.randint(0, 100, (1, 8), device=dev, dtype=torch.long)
                try:
                    self.model(input_ids=dummy, attention_mask=torch.ones_like(dummy))
                except Exception:
                    try:
                        self.model(dummy)
                    except Exception as e2:
                        logger.warning("DeltaKV: forward check failed: %s", e2)
                        forward_check_success = False
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("DeltaKV: forward check raised: %s", e)
            forward_check_success = False

        try:
            self._compressed_params = self._count_params(self.model)
        except Exception:
            self._compressed_params = sum(p.numel() for p in self.model.parameters())

        effective_ratio = total_comp_params / total_orig_params if total_orig_params > 0 else 1.0
        avg_err = (
            sum(self.layer_errors.values()) / max(1, len(self.layer_errors))
            if self.layer_errors
            else 0.0
        )

        try:
            stats = self.get_compression_stats()
        except Exception:
            stats = {}

        stats.update(
            {
                "rank": self.rank,
                "sparsity": self.sparsity,
                "max_error": self.max_error,
                "target_attention_only": self.target_attention_only,
                "fallback_to_original": self.fallback_to_original,
                "compressed_layers": self.compressed_layers,
                "compressed_layer_count": len(self.compressed_layers),
                "fallback_layers": self.fallback_layers,
                "fallback_layer_count": len(self.fallback_layers),
                "skipped_layers": self.skipped_layers,
                "skipped_layer_count": len(self.skipped_layers),
                "layer_errors": self.layer_errors,
                "layer_ranks": self.layer_ranks,
                "avg_reconstruction_error": avg_err,
                "effective_parameter_ratio": round(effective_ratio, 4),
                "kv_cache_storage_ratio": f"{self.sparsity * 100:.1f}% of full KV cache",
                "forward_check_success": forward_check_success,
                "method": "delta_kv",
                "note": (
                    "DeltaKV rewrites dense weights in-place (low-rank + sparse residual). "
                    "The stored weight retains its full (out, in) shape; framework-level "
                    "compression_rate reads 1.0. Use effective_parameter_ratio for the "
                    "theoretical storage metric."
                ),
            }
        )
        self.stats = stats

        # DKV-FIX-14: write stats on the model.
        try:
            if not hasattr(self.model, "compression_stats") or self.model.compression_stats is None:
                self.model.compression_stats = {}
            self.model.compression_stats.update(
                {
                    "num_compressed": len(self.compressed_layers),
                    "num_fallback": len(self.fallback_layers),
                    "compression_method": "delta_kv",
                    "effective_parameter_ratio": effective_ratio,
                    "avg_reconstruction_error": avg_err,
                }
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

        self.model._delta_kv_compressed = True
        logger.info(
            "DeltaKV: %d compressed, %d fallback, %d skipped. "
            "Avg err %.4f, effective_param_ratio %.2fx.",
            len(self.compressed_layers),
            len(self.fallback_layers),
            len(self.skipped_layers),
            avg_err,
            effective_ratio,
        )
        return self.model, stats

class DeltaKVStore:
    """
    Optional runtime cache that stores delta residuals relative to retrieved
    historical K/V references. Not used by the weight-only compressor path.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        max_refs: int = 128,
        topk: int = 4,
        compression_ratio: float = 0.29,
        residual_threshold: float = 1e-3,
    ) -> None:
        self.max_refs = int(max_refs)
        self.topk = int(topk)
        self.compression_ratio = float(compression_ratio)
        self.residual_threshold = float(residual_threshold)
        self.ref_k: torch.Tensor | None = None
        self.ref_v: torch.Tensor | None = None

    def reset(self) -> None:
        self.ref_k = None
        self.ref_v = None

    @torch.no_grad()
    def update(self, k: torch.Tensor, v: torch.Tensor) -> None:
        orig_k = k.detach()
        orig_v = v.detach()
        if orig_k.ndim == 2:
            orig_k = orig_k.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
            orig_v = orig_v.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
        elif orig_k.ndim == 3:
            orig_k = orig_k.unsqueeze(1)
            orig_v = orig_v.unsqueeze(1)

        B, H, N, D = orig_k.shape
        if N == 0 or B == 0:
            return

        if self.ref_k is None:
            self.ref_k = orig_k
            self.ref_v = orig_v
        else:
            if self.ref_k.device != orig_k.device or self.ref_k.dtype != orig_k.dtype:
                self.ref_k = self.ref_k.to(device=orig_k.device, dtype=orig_k.dtype)
                self.ref_v = self.ref_v.to(device=orig_v.device, dtype=orig_v.dtype)

            if self.ref_k.shape[0] != B:
                self.ref_k = self.ref_k[:1].expand(B, -1, -1, -1).clone()
                self.ref_v = self.ref_v[:1].expand(B, -1, -1, -1).clone()

            self.ref_k = torch.cat([self.ref_k, orig_k], dim=2)
            self.ref_v = torch.cat([self.ref_v, orig_v], dim=2)

        if self.ref_k.size(2) > self.max_refs:
            self.ref_k = self.ref_k[:, :, -self.max_refs :, :].contiguous()
            self.ref_v = self.ref_v[:, :, -self.max_refs :, :].contiguous()

    @torch.no_grad()
    def compress(
        self,
        k: torch.Tensor,
        v: torch.Tensor,
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        orig_shape = k.shape
        if self.ref_k is None or self.ref_k.size(2) == 0:
            self.update(k, v)
            return k, v

        k_4d = k
        v_4d = v
        if k.ndim == 2:
            k_4d = k.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
            v_4d = v.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
        elif k.ndim == 3:
            k_4d = k.unsqueeze(1)
            v_4d = v.unsqueeze(1)

        B, H, N, D = k_4d.shape
        ref_b, ref_h, ref_n, ref_d = self.ref_k.shape

        ref_k_cur = self.ref_k.to(device=k.device, dtype=k.dtype)
        ref_v_cur = self.ref_v.to(device=v.device, dtype=v.dtype)

        ref_k_b = ref_k_cur if ref_b == B else ref_k_cur[:1].expand(B, -1, -1, -1)
        ref_v_b = ref_v_cur if ref_b == B else ref_v_cur[:1].expand(B, -1, -1, -1)

        tk = min(self.topk, ref_n)
        if tk == 0:
            self.update(k, v)
            return k, v

        sim = torch.matmul(k_4d.float(), ref_k_b.float().transpose(-2, -1).contiguous()) / (D**0.5)
        _, top_idx = torch.topk(sim, tk, dim=-1)

        top_idx_exp = top_idx.unsqueeze(-1).expand(B, H, N, tk, D)
        ref_k_exp = ref_k_b.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, H, N, ref_n, D)
        ref_v_exp = ref_v_b.unsqueeze(2).expand(B, H, N, ref_n, D)

        rk = ref_k_exp.gather(3, top_idx_exp).mean(dim=3).to(dtype=k_4d.dtype)
        rv = ref_v_exp.gather(3, top_idx_exp).mean(dim=3).to(dtype=v_4d.dtype)

        k_residual = k_4d - rk
        v_residual = v_4d - rv

        k_norm = torch.norm(k_residual.float(), dim=-1, keepdim=True)
        v_norm = torch.norm(v_residual.float(), dim=-1, keepdim=True)

        k_mask = (k_norm > self.residual_threshold).to(dtype=k_4d.dtype)
        v_mask = (v_norm > self.residual_threshold).to(dtype=v_4d.dtype)

        k_hat = rk + k_residual * k_mask
        v_hat = rv + v_residual * v_mask

        self.update(k, v)
        return k_hat.reshape(orig_shape), v_hat.reshape(orig_shape)
