class LSCPrunedLoRALinear(nn.Module):
    # LSC-FIX-07: this is a linear layer, not an attention module.
    is_custom_attention: bool = False
    is_custom_linear: bool = True

    def __init__(
        self,
        in_features: int,
        out_features: int,
        weight: torch.Tensor,
        bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        lora_r: int = 0,
        lora_alpha: float = 1.0,
        device: torch.device | None = None,
        dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.in_features = in_features
        self.out_features = out_features
        self.nf = out_features  # Conv1D compatibility
        self.lora_r = int(lora_r)
        self.lora_alpha = float(lora_alpha)
        self.scaling = (self.lora_alpha / self.lora_r) if self.lora_r > 0 else 1.0
        self.rank = self.lora_r  # Alias for detection

        target_device = device if device is not None else weight.device
        target_dtype = dtype if dtype is not None else weight.dtype

        self.weight = nn.Parameter(
            weight.to(device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype),
            requires_grad=False,
        )
        if bias is not None:
            self.bias = nn.Parameter(
                bias.to(device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype),
                requires_grad=False,
            )
        else:
            self.register_parameter("bias", None)

        if self.lora_r > 0:
            # LSC-FIX-03: LoRA parameters in base weight's dtype for forward consistency.
            self.lora_A = nn.Parameter(
                torch.empty((self.lora_r, in_features), dtype=target_dtype, device=target_device)
            )
            self.lora_B = nn.Parameter(
                torch.zeros(
                    (out_features, self.lora_r),
                    dtype=target_dtype,
                    device=target_device,
                )
            )
            nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.lora_A, a=math.sqrt(5))
        else:
            self.register_parameter("lora_A", None)
            self.register_parameter("lora_B", None)

    @classmethod
    def from_linear(
        cls,
        linear: nn.Module,
        weight: torch.Tensor,
        lora_r: int = 0,
        lora_alpha: float = 1.0,
    ) -> LSCPrunedLoRALinear:
        base_layer = getattr(linear, "base_layer", linear)
        bias = (
            base_layer.bias.detach()
            if hasattr(base_layer, "bias") and base_layer.bias is not None
            else None
        )
        in_features = getattr(base_layer, "in_features", weight.shape[1])
        out_features = getattr(base_layer, "out_features", weight.shape[0])

        existing_lora_r = _detect_lora_rank(linear)
        eff_lora_r = existing_lora_r if existing_lora_r > 0 else lora_r
        eff_lora_alpha = _detect_lora_alpha(linear) if existing_lora_r > 0 else lora_alpha

        layer = cls(
            in_features=in_features,
            out_features=out_features,
            weight=weight,
            bias=bias,
            lora_r=eff_lora_r,
            lora_alpha=eff_lora_alpha,
            device=weight.device,
            dtype=weight.dtype,
        )

        # Preserve existing LoRA if shapes match.
        if (
            hasattr(linear, "lora_A")
            and hasattr(linear, "lora_B")
            and layer.lora_A is not None
            and layer.lora_B is not None
        ):
            with torch.no_grad():
                src_A = getattr(linear.lora_A, "weight", linear.lora_A)
                src_B = getattr(linear.lora_B, "weight", linear.lora_B)
                if isinstance(src_A, torch.Tensor) and src_A.shape == layer.lora_A.shape:
                    layer.lora_A.data.copy_(src_A.to(layer.lora_A.device, dtype=layer.lora_A.dtype))
                if isinstance(src_B, torch.Tensor) and src_B.shape == layer.lora_B.shape:
                    layer.lora_B.data.copy_(src_B.to(layer.lora_B.device, dtype=layer.lora_B.dtype))

        if layer.lora_A is not None:
            layer.lora_A.requires_grad = True
        if layer.lora_B is not None:
            layer.lora_B.requires_grad = True

        return layer

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        out = F.linear(x, self.weight, self.bias)
        if self.lora_r > 0 and self.lora_A is not None and self.lora_B is not None:
            # Preserve dtype consistency: do the LoRA computation in the
            # base weight's dtype (input dtype may differ).
            lora_out = F.linear(F.linear(x, self.lora_A), self.lora_B)
            out = out + self.scaling * lora_out.to(out.dtype)
        return out

Base class for all neural network modules.

Your models should also subclass this class.

Modules can also contain other Modules, allowing them to be nested in a tree structure. You can assign the submodules as regular attributes::

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(1, 20, 5)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(20, 20, 5)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = F.relu(self.conv1(x))
        return F.relu(self.conv2(x))

Submodules assigned in this way will be registered, and will also have their parameters converted when you call :meth:to, etc.

Note

As per the example above, an __init__() call to the parent class must be made before assignment on the child.

Should be overridden by all subclasses.

Note

Although the recipe for forward pass needs to be defined within this function, one should call the :class:Module instance afterwards instead of this since the former takes care of running the registered hooks while the latter silently ignores them.

@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("lillama_class")
@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("lillama_compressor_class")
@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("lillama_distiller_class")
class LiLLaMADistiller(BaseCompressor):
    # LL-FIX-01: this is a local distillation / weight-rewriter, not standard factorized attention.
    is_custom_attention: bool = False
    category: str = "weight_rewriting"

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: nn.Module,
        tokenizer: Any | None = None,
        rank: int = 32,
        calibration_texts: list[str] | None = None,
        calibration_loader: Any | None = None,
        device: str | torch.device | None = None,
        max_error: float = 0.20,
        fallback_to_original: bool = True,
        skip_attention: bool = False,
        target_attention_only: bool = False,
        target_modules: list[str] | None = None,
        min_layer_dim: int = 8,
        skip_should_compress_filter: bool = False,
        max_calibration_batches: int = 8,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(model, name="lillama", **kwargs)
        cfg = kwargs.get("comp_config", kwargs.get("cfg"))
        if cfg is not None:
            rank = _cfg_get(cfg, "lillama_rank", _cfg_get(cfg, "rank", rank))
            max_error = _cfg_get(cfg, "max_error", max_error)
            fallback_to_original = _cfg_get(cfg, "fallback_to_original", fallback_to_original)
            skip_attention = _cfg_get(cfg, "skip_attention", skip_attention)
            target_attention_only = _cfg_get(cfg, "target_attention_only", target_attention_only)
            min_layer_dim = _cfg_get(cfg, "min_layer_dim", min_layer_dim)
            skip_should_compress_filter = _cfg_get(
                cfg,
                "skip_should_compress_filter",
                skip_should_compress_filter,
            )
            max_calibration_batches = _cfg_get(
                cfg, "max_calibration_batches", max_calibration_batches
            )

        # LL-FIX-11: tokenizer resolution.
        self.tokenizer = (
            tokenizer
            or getattr(model, "tokenizer", None)
            or getattr(getattr(model, "config", None), "tokenizer", None)
        )
        self.rank = max(1, int(rank))
        self.calibration_texts = calibration_texts
        self.calibration_loader = calibration_loader
        self.max_error = float(max_error)
        self.fallback_to_original = bool(fallback_to_original)
        self.skip_attention = bool(skip_attention)
        self.target_attention_only = bool(target_attention_only)
        self.target_modules = target_modules
        self.min_layer_dim = max(1, int(min_layer_dim))
        self.skip_should_compress_filter = bool(skip_should_compress_filter)
        self.max_calibration_batches = max(1, int(max_calibration_batches))

        # LL-FIX-03: safe device.
        if device is not None:
            self.target_device = torch.device(device)
        else:
            self.target_device = _get_device(model)

        # LL-FIX-15: initialize all lists in __init__.
        self.compressed_layers: list[str] = []
        self.fallback_layers: list[str] = []
        self.layer_errors: dict[str, float] = {}
        self.layer_details: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.stats: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self._compressed_params: int = 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Target check (LL-FIX-06)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _is_target_module(self, name: str, module: nn.Module, _debug: bool = False) -> bool:
        name_lower = name.lower()
        if any(part in name.split(".") for part in ("lora_A", "lora_B", "base_layer")):
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: lora/base_layer part")
            return False

        # Skip already-compressed.
        cls_name = module.__class__.__name__
        if cls_name in (
            "LSCPrunedLoRALinear",
            "DynamicSVDLinear",
            "SVDLinear",
            "FactorisedLinear",
            "LowRankPlusSparseLinear",
        ):
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: already compressed ({cls_name})")
            return False

        if any(
            skip in name_lower
            for skip in [
                "classifier",
                "score",
                "lm_head",
                "pooler",
                "embedding",
                "router",
                "gate",
            ]
        ):
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: skip keyword")
            return False

        target_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
        cls_lower = target_mod.__class__.__name__.lower()
        is_linear_like = (
            isinstance(target_mod, nn.Linear) or "conv1d" in cls_lower or hasattr(target_mod, "nf")
        )
        if not is_linear_like:
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: not linear-like")
            return False

        # LL-FIX-09: allow bypassing framework filter.
        if not self.skip_should_compress_filter:
            try:
                if not should_compress_linear(self.model, name):
                    if _debug:
                        logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: should_compress_linear=False")
                    return False
            except Exception as e:
                if _debug:
                    logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: should_compress_linear raised {e}")
                return False

        # LL-FIX-10: filter tiny layers.
        w = getattr(target_mod, "weight", None)
        if w is None:
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: weight None")
            return False
        if min(w.shape[0], w.shape[1]) < self.min_layer_dim:
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: dim too small {tuple(w.shape)}")
            return False

        if self.target_attention_only:
            is_attn = any(k in name_lower for k in _ATTN_NAMES)
            if not is_attn:
                if _debug:
                    logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: not attention")
                return False

        if self.skip_attention:
            attn_keywords = {
                "query",
                "key",
                "value",
                "q_lin",
                "k_lin",
                "v_lin",
                "q_proj",
                "k_proj",
                "v_proj",
                "out_lin",
                "out_proj",
                "dense",
                "o_proj",
                "c_attn",
            }
            last = name.split(".")[-1].lower()
            if last in attn_keywords or any(k in name_lower for k in ("self_attn", "attn.c_attn")):
                if _debug:
                    logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: skip_attention")
                return False

        if self.target_modules is not None:
            ok = any(t in name for t in self.target_modules)
            if not ok and _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: not in target_modules")
            return ok

        if _debug:
            logger.info(f"  [TARGET] {name}: shape={tuple(w.shape)}")
        return True

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # IO activation collection
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _collect_io_activations(
        self,
    ) -> dict[str, tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]]:
        """Collect input/output activations across target layers."""
        self.model.eval()
        activations: dict[str, dict[str, list[torch.Tensor]]] = {}
        hooks = []

        def make_hook(layer_name: str):
            def hook(module: nn.Module, inputs: tuple[Any, ...], output: Any):
                inp = inputs[0].detach() if inputs and isinstance(inputs[0], torch.Tensor) else None
                if isinstance(output, torch.Tensor):
                    out = output.detach()
                elif (
                    isinstance(output, (tuple, list))
                    and output
                    and isinstance(output[0], torch.Tensor)
                ):
                    out = output[0].detach()
                else:
                    out = None
                if inp is not None and out is not None:
                    if layer_name not in activations:
                        activations[layer_name] = {"in": [], "out": []}
                    activations[layer_name]["in"].append(inp.cpu())
                    activations[layer_name]["out"].append(out.cpu())

            return hook

        target_list = [
            (name, module)
            for name, module in self.model.named_modules()
            if self._is_target_module(name, module)
        ]
        if not target_list:
            return {}

        for name, module in target_list:
            hooks.append(module.register_forward_hook(make_hook(name)))

        try:
            calib_inputs = get_calibration_tensors(
                self.model,
                tokenizer=self.tokenizer,
                calibration_loader=self.calibration_loader,
                calibration_texts=self.calibration_texts,
                device=self.target_device,
            )
            batches = self._normalize_batches(calib_inputs)
            n_batches = min(len(batches), self.max_calibration_batches)
            with torch.no_grad():
                for i in range(n_batches):
                    batch = batches[i]
                    try:
                        if isinstance(batch, dict):
                            batch = {
                                k: (v.to(self.target_device) if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) else v)
                                for k, v in batch.items()
                            }
                            self.model(**batch)
                        elif isinstance(batch, torch.Tensor):
                            self.model(batch.to(self.target_device))
                        elif isinstance(batch, (list, tuple)):
                            batch = [
                                (v.to(self.target_device) if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) else v)
                                for v in batch
                            ]
                            self.model(*batch)
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.debug("Calibration batch %d failed: %s", i, e)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("LiLLaMA: calibration forward raised: %s", e)
        finally:
            for h in hooks:
                h.remove()

        aggregated: dict[str, tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]] = {}
        MAX_ACTIVATION_SAMPLES = 512
        for name, data in activations.items():
            if data["in"] and data["out"]:
                try:
                    cat_in = torch.cat(data["in"], dim=0)
                    cat_out = torch.cat(data["out"], dim=0)
                    if cat_in.size(0) > MAX_ACTIVATION_SAMPLES:
                        cat_in = cat_in[:MAX_ACTIVATION_SAMPLES]
                        cat_out = cat_out[:MAX_ACTIVATION_SAMPLES]
                    aggregated[name] = (cat_in, cat_out)
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.debug("Activation concat failed for %s: %s", name, e)
        return aggregated

    @staticmethod
    def _normalize_batches(calib_inputs: Any) -> list[Any]:
        if calib_inputs is None:
            return []
        if isinstance(calib_inputs, torch.Tensor):
            return [calib_inputs]
        if isinstance(calib_inputs, dict):
            return [calib_inputs]
        if isinstance(calib_inputs, (list, tuple)):
            if len(calib_inputs) == 0:
                return []
            first = calib_inputs[0]
            if isinstance(first, (dict, torch.Tensor)):
                return list(calib_inputs)
            return [calib_inputs]
        return [calib_inputs]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SVD factorization helper
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _factorize(
        self,
        W: torch.Tensor,
        rank: int,
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, int]:
        """Return (W_recon, rank_used)."""
        try:
            U, S, Vh = torch.linalg.svd(W, full_matrices=False)
            total_energy = (S**2).sum().clamp(min=1e-12)
            cum_ratio = torch.cumsum(S**2, 0) / total_energy
            r = min(rank, len(S))
            cum_e = cum_ratio[r - 1].item() if r > 0 else 0.0
            if cum_e < 0.95:
                idx = torch.where(cum_ratio >= 0.95)[0]
                if len(idx) > 0:
                    r = min(int(idx[0].item()) + 1, len(S))
            W_recon = (U[:, :r] * S[:r].unsqueeze(0)) @ Vh[:r, :]
            return W_recon, r
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug("LiLLaMA SVD factorization failed: %s", e)
            return W, 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Main compress
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def compress(self, **kwargs: Any) -> tuple[nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
        # LL-FIX-08: idempotence.
        if getattr(self.model, "_lillama_compressed", False):
            logger.warning("LiLLaMA: model already compressed; skipping.")
            try:
                return self.model, self.get_compression_stats()
            except Exception:
                return self.model, {}

        self.compressed_layers = []
        self.fallback_layers = []
        self.layer_errors = {}
        self.layer_details = {}

        activations_map = self._collect_io_activations()
        logger.info("LiLLaMA: %d target activation sets collected.", len(activations_map))

        # LL-FIX-06: diagnostic if no targets.
        target_list = [
            (name, module)
            for name, module in self.model.named_modules()
            if self._is_target_module(name, module)
        ]
        if not target_list:
            logger.warning("LiLLaMA: no compressible layers found. Running diagnostic...")
            n_scanned = 0
            for name, module in self.model.named_modules():
                n_scanned += 1
                self._is_target_module(name, module, _debug=True)
            logger.warning("LiLLaMA diagnostic: %d modules scanned, 0 targets.", n_scanned)
            try:
                return self.model, self.get_compression_stats()
            except Exception:
                return self.model, {}

        logger.info("LiLLaMA: %d target layers identified.", len(target_list))

        total_orig_params = 0
        total_comp_params = 0

        # Deduplicated parameter accounting.
        seen_param_ids: set = set()
        count_param_ids: set = set()

        for p in self.model.parameters():
            if id(p) not in seen_param_ids:
                seen_param_ids.add(id(p))
                total_orig_params += p.numel()

        def _count_params_of(mod: nn.Module):
            nonlocal total_comp_params
            for p in mod.parameters(recurse=False):
                if id(p) not in count_param_ids:
                    count_param_ids.add(id(p))
                    total_comp_params += p.numel()

        for name, module in target_list:
            target_layer = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
            raw_w = target_layer.weight.data
            is_conv1d = _is_conv1d(target_layer)
            device = raw_w.device
            dtype = target_layer.weight.dtype

            W = raw_w.t().contiguous().clone().float() if is_conv1d else raw_w.clone().float()
            d_out, d_in = W.shape
            used_cross_cov = False
            r_used = self.rank

            # LL-FIX-04: initialize W_new to W (safe default).
            W_new = W

            if name in activations_map:
                inp, out = activations_map[name]
                try:
                    inp_flat = inp.reshape(-1, inp.shape[-1]).float()
                    out_flat = out.reshape(-1, out.shape[-1]).float()
                    if inp_flat.shape[-1] == d_in and out_flat.shape[-1] == d_out:
                        C = torch.matmul(out_flat.t().contiguous(), inp_flat) / max(
                            len(inp_flat), 1
                        )
                        W_new, r_used = self._factorize(C, self.rank)
                        used_cross_cov = True
                    else:
                        W_new, r_used = self._factorize(W, self.rank)
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.debug("Cross-covariance factorization failed for %s: %s", name, e)
                    W_new, r_used = self._factorize(W, self.rank)
            else:
                W_new, r_used = self._factorize(W, self.rank)

            norm_orig = torch.norm(W, p="fro")
            rel_err = (torch.norm(W - W_new, p="fro") / (norm_orig + 1e-8)).item()
            self.layer_errors[name] = rel_err

            if rel_err > self.max_error:
                logger.warning(
                    "LiLLaMA: err %.4f on %s > %.4f. %s",
                    rel_err,
                    name,
                    self.max_error,
                    (
                        "Keeping original."
                        if self.fallback_to_original
                        else "Proceeding with distilled weights."
                    ),
                )
                if self.fallback_to_original:
                    self.fallback_layers.append(name)
                    for p in module.parameters(recurse=False):
                        p.requires_grad = False
                    _count_params_of(module)
                    continue

            # Shape integrity check.
            final_w = W_new.t().contiguous() if is_conv1d else W_new
            if final_w.shape != target_layer.weight.shape:
                logger.warning(
                    "LiLLaMA: shape mismatch for %s: expected %s, got %s; skipping.",
                    name,
                    tuple(target_layer.weight.shape),
                    tuple(final_w.shape),
                )
                _count_params_of(module)
                continue

            target_layer.weight.data.copy_(final_w.to(dtype=dtype, device=device))
            target_layer.weight.requires_grad = False
            if getattr(target_layer, "bias", None) is not None:
                target_layer.bias.requires_grad = False

            # Preserve LoRA adapter trainability.
            if hasattr(module, "lora_A") and hasattr(module, "lora_B"):
                for attr in ("lora_A", "lora_B"):
                    p = getattr(module, attr, None)
                    if p is None:
                        continue
                    if hasattr(p, "weight"):
                        p.weight.requires_grad = True
                    elif isinstance(p, nn.Parameter):
                        p.requires_grad = True

            self.compressed_layers.append(name)
            _count_params_of(module)

            self.layer_details[name] = {
                "rank": int(r_used),
                "rel_error": float(rel_err),
                "used_cross_cov": bool(used_cross_cov),
                "shape": tuple(final_w.shape),
            }

        # LL-FIX-07: forward sanity check.
        forward_check_success = True
        try:
            with torch.no_grad():
                dummy = torch.randint(0, 100, (1, 8), device=self.target_device, dtype=torch.long)
                try:
                    self.model(input_ids=dummy, attention_mask=torch.ones_like(dummy))
                except Exception:
                    try:
                        self.model(dummy)
                    except Exception as e2:
                        logger.warning("LiLLaMA: forward check failed: %s", e2)
                        forward_check_success = False
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("LiLLaMA: forward check raised: %s", e)
            forward_check_success = False

        try:
            self._compressed_params = self._count_params(self.model)
        except Exception:
            self._compressed_params = sum(p.numel() for p in self.model.parameters())

        # LL-FIX-04: avg error only over compressed layers.
        compressed_errs = [
            self.layer_errors[n] for n in self.compressed_layers if n in self.layer_errors
        ]
        avg_err = sum(compressed_errs) / len(compressed_errs) if compressed_errs else 0.0
        eff_ratio = total_comp_params / max(1, total_orig_params)

        try:
            stats = self.get_compression_stats()
        except Exception:
            stats = {}

        stats.update(
            {
                "distilled_layers": len(self.compressed_layers),
                "compressed_layers": self.compressed_layers,
                "fallback_layers": self.fallback_layers,
                "num_compressed": len(self.compressed_layers),
                "num_fallback": len(self.fallback_layers),
                "rank": self.rank,
                "max_error": self.max_error,
                "fallback_to_original": self.fallback_to_original,
                "avg_reconstruction_error": avg_err,
                "layer_errors": self.layer_errors,
                "layer_details": self.layer_details,
                "effective_parameter_ratio": eff_ratio,
                "forward_check_success": forward_check_success,
                "method": "lillama_cross_covariance_svd",
                # LL-FIX-12: honest note.
                "note": (
                    "LiLLaMA rewrites weights in-place with the distilled reconstruction. "
                    "The dense weight keeps its full (out, in) shape; framework-level "
                    "compression_rate reads 1.0. Use effective_parameter_ratio for the "
                    "theoretical storage metric."
                ),
            }
        )
        self.stats = stats

        # LL-FIX-13: write stats onto model.
        try:
            if not hasattr(self.model, "compression_stats") or self.model.compression_stats is None:
                self.model.compression_stats = {}
            self.model.compression_stats.update(
                {
                    "num_compressed": len(self.compressed_layers),
                    "num_fallback": len(self.fallback_layers),
                    "compression_method": "lillama_cross_covariance_svd",
                    "effective_parameter_ratio": eff_ratio,
                    "avg_reconstruction_error": avg_err,
                }
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

        self.model._lillama_compressed = True
        logger.info(
            "LiLLaMA: %d distilled, %d fallback. Avg err %.4f, eff_param_ratio %.2fx.",
            len(self.compressed_layers),
            len(self.fallback_layers),
            avg_err,
            eff_ratio,
        )
        return self.model, stats

def compress(self, **kwargs: Any) -> tuple[nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
    # LL-FIX-08: idempotence.
    if getattr(self.model, "_lillama_compressed", False):
        logger.warning("LiLLaMA: model already compressed; skipping.")
        try:
            return self.model, self.get_compression_stats()
        except Exception:
            return self.model, {}

    self.compressed_layers = []
    self.fallback_layers = []
    self.layer_errors = {}
    self.layer_details = {}

    activations_map = self._collect_io_activations()
    logger.info("LiLLaMA: %d target activation sets collected.", len(activations_map))

    # LL-FIX-06: diagnostic if no targets.
    target_list = [
        (name, module)
        for name, module in self.model.named_modules()
        if self._is_target_module(name, module)
    ]
    if not target_list:
        logger.warning("LiLLaMA: no compressible layers found. Running diagnostic...")
        n_scanned = 0
        for name, module in self.model.named_modules():
            n_scanned += 1
            self._is_target_module(name, module, _debug=True)
        logger.warning("LiLLaMA diagnostic: %d modules scanned, 0 targets.", n_scanned)
        try:
            return self.model, self.get_compression_stats()
        except Exception:
            return self.model, {}

    logger.info("LiLLaMA: %d target layers identified.", len(target_list))

    total_orig_params = 0
    total_comp_params = 0

    # Deduplicated parameter accounting.
    seen_param_ids: set = set()
    count_param_ids: set = set()

    for p in self.model.parameters():
        if id(p) not in seen_param_ids:
            seen_param_ids.add(id(p))
            total_orig_params += p.numel()

    def _count_params_of(mod: nn.Module):
        nonlocal total_comp_params
        for p in mod.parameters(recurse=False):
            if id(p) not in count_param_ids:
                count_param_ids.add(id(p))
                total_comp_params += p.numel()

    for name, module in target_list:
        target_layer = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
        raw_w = target_layer.weight.data
        is_conv1d = _is_conv1d(target_layer)
        device = raw_w.device
        dtype = target_layer.weight.dtype

        W = raw_w.t().contiguous().clone().float() if is_conv1d else raw_w.clone().float()
        d_out, d_in = W.shape
        used_cross_cov = False
        r_used = self.rank

        # LL-FIX-04: initialize W_new to W (safe default).
        W_new = W

        if name in activations_map:
            inp, out = activations_map[name]
            try:
                inp_flat = inp.reshape(-1, inp.shape[-1]).float()
                out_flat = out.reshape(-1, out.shape[-1]).float()
                if inp_flat.shape[-1] == d_in and out_flat.shape[-1] == d_out:
                    C = torch.matmul(out_flat.t().contiguous(), inp_flat) / max(
                        len(inp_flat), 1
                    )
                    W_new, r_used = self._factorize(C, self.rank)
                    used_cross_cov = True
                else:
                    W_new, r_used = self._factorize(W, self.rank)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.debug("Cross-covariance factorization failed for %s: %s", name, e)
                W_new, r_used = self._factorize(W, self.rank)
        else:
            W_new, r_used = self._factorize(W, self.rank)

        norm_orig = torch.norm(W, p="fro")
        rel_err = (torch.norm(W - W_new, p="fro") / (norm_orig + 1e-8)).item()
        self.layer_errors[name] = rel_err

        if rel_err > self.max_error:
            logger.warning(
                "LiLLaMA: err %.4f on %s > %.4f. %s",
                rel_err,
                name,
                self.max_error,
                (
                    "Keeping original."
                    if self.fallback_to_original
                    else "Proceeding with distilled weights."
                ),
            )
            if self.fallback_to_original:
                self.fallback_layers.append(name)
                for p in module.parameters(recurse=False):
                    p.requires_grad = False
                _count_params_of(module)
                continue

        # Shape integrity check.
        final_w = W_new.t().contiguous() if is_conv1d else W_new
        if final_w.shape != target_layer.weight.shape:
            logger.warning(
                "LiLLaMA: shape mismatch for %s: expected %s, got %s; skipping.",
                name,
                tuple(target_layer.weight.shape),
                tuple(final_w.shape),
            )
            _count_params_of(module)
            continue

        target_layer.weight.data.copy_(final_w.to(dtype=dtype, device=device))
        target_layer.weight.requires_grad = False
        if getattr(target_layer, "bias", None) is not None:
            target_layer.bias.requires_grad = False

        # Preserve LoRA adapter trainability.
        if hasattr(module, "lora_A") and hasattr(module, "lora_B"):
            for attr in ("lora_A", "lora_B"):
                p = getattr(module, attr, None)
                if p is None:
                    continue
                if hasattr(p, "weight"):
                    p.weight.requires_grad = True
                elif isinstance(p, nn.Parameter):
                    p.requires_grad = True

        self.compressed_layers.append(name)
        _count_params_of(module)

        self.layer_details[name] = {
            "rank": int(r_used),
            "rel_error": float(rel_err),
            "used_cross_cov": bool(used_cross_cov),
            "shape": tuple(final_w.shape),
        }

    # LL-FIX-07: forward sanity check.
    forward_check_success = True
    try:
        with torch.no_grad():
            dummy = torch.randint(0, 100, (1, 8), device=self.target_device, dtype=torch.long)
            try:
                self.model(input_ids=dummy, attention_mask=torch.ones_like(dummy))
            except Exception:
                try:
                    self.model(dummy)
                except Exception as e2:
                    logger.warning("LiLLaMA: forward check failed: %s", e2)
                    forward_check_success = False
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning("LiLLaMA: forward check raised: %s", e)
        forward_check_success = False

    try:
        self._compressed_params = self._count_params(self.model)
    except Exception:
        self._compressed_params = sum(p.numel() for p in self.model.parameters())

    # LL-FIX-04: avg error only over compressed layers.
    compressed_errs = [
        self.layer_errors[n] for n in self.compressed_layers if n in self.layer_errors
    ]
    avg_err = sum(compressed_errs) / len(compressed_errs) if compressed_errs else 0.0
    eff_ratio = total_comp_params / max(1, total_orig_params)

    try:
        stats = self.get_compression_stats()
    except Exception:
        stats = {}

    stats.update(
        {
            "distilled_layers": len(self.compressed_layers),
            "compressed_layers": self.compressed_layers,
            "fallback_layers": self.fallback_layers,
            "num_compressed": len(self.compressed_layers),
            "num_fallback": len(self.fallback_layers),
            "rank": self.rank,
            "max_error": self.max_error,
            "fallback_to_original": self.fallback_to_original,
            "avg_reconstruction_error": avg_err,
            "layer_errors": self.layer_errors,
            "layer_details": self.layer_details,
            "effective_parameter_ratio": eff_ratio,
            "forward_check_success": forward_check_success,
            "method": "lillama_cross_covariance_svd",
            # LL-FIX-12: honest note.
            "note": (
                "LiLLaMA rewrites weights in-place with the distilled reconstruction. "
                "The dense weight keeps its full (out, in) shape; framework-level "
                "compression_rate reads 1.0. Use effective_parameter_ratio for the "
                "theoretical storage metric."
            ),
        }
    )
    self.stats = stats

    # LL-FIX-13: write stats onto model.
    try:
        if not hasattr(self.model, "compression_stats") or self.model.compression_stats is None:
            self.model.compression_stats = {}
        self.model.compression_stats.update(
            {
                "num_compressed": len(self.compressed_layers),
                "num_fallback": len(self.fallback_layers),
                "compression_method": "lillama_cross_covariance_svd",
                "effective_parameter_ratio": eff_ratio,
                "avg_reconstruction_error": avg_err,
            }
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    self.model._lillama_compressed = True
    logger.info(
        "LiLLaMA: %d distilled, %d fallback. Avg err %.4f, eff_param_ratio %.2fx.",
        len(self.compressed_layers),
        len(self.fallback_layers),
        avg_err,
        eff_ratio,
    )
    return self.model, stats

@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("lillama_class")
@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("lillama_compressor_class")
@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("lillama_distiller_class")
class LiLLaMADistiller(BaseCompressor):
    # LL-FIX-01: this is a local distillation / weight-rewriter, not standard factorized attention.
    is_custom_attention: bool = False
    category: str = "weight_rewriting"

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: nn.Module,
        tokenizer: Any | None = None,
        rank: int = 32,
        calibration_texts: list[str] | None = None,
        calibration_loader: Any | None = None,
        device: str | torch.device | None = None,
        max_error: float = 0.20,
        fallback_to_original: bool = True,
        skip_attention: bool = False,
        target_attention_only: bool = False,
        target_modules: list[str] | None = None,
        min_layer_dim: int = 8,
        skip_should_compress_filter: bool = False,
        max_calibration_batches: int = 8,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(model, name="lillama", **kwargs)
        cfg = kwargs.get("comp_config", kwargs.get("cfg"))
        if cfg is not None:
            rank = _cfg_get(cfg, "lillama_rank", _cfg_get(cfg, "rank", rank))
            max_error = _cfg_get(cfg, "max_error", max_error)
            fallback_to_original = _cfg_get(cfg, "fallback_to_original", fallback_to_original)
            skip_attention = _cfg_get(cfg, "skip_attention", skip_attention)
            target_attention_only = _cfg_get(cfg, "target_attention_only", target_attention_only)
            min_layer_dim = _cfg_get(cfg, "min_layer_dim", min_layer_dim)
            skip_should_compress_filter = _cfg_get(
                cfg,
                "skip_should_compress_filter",
                skip_should_compress_filter,
            )
            max_calibration_batches = _cfg_get(
                cfg, "max_calibration_batches", max_calibration_batches
            )

        # LL-FIX-11: tokenizer resolution.
        self.tokenizer = (
            tokenizer
            or getattr(model, "tokenizer", None)
            or getattr(getattr(model, "config", None), "tokenizer", None)
        )
        self.rank = max(1, int(rank))
        self.calibration_texts = calibration_texts
        self.calibration_loader = calibration_loader
        self.max_error = float(max_error)
        self.fallback_to_original = bool(fallback_to_original)
        self.skip_attention = bool(skip_attention)
        self.target_attention_only = bool(target_attention_only)
        self.target_modules = target_modules
        self.min_layer_dim = max(1, int(min_layer_dim))
        self.skip_should_compress_filter = bool(skip_should_compress_filter)
        self.max_calibration_batches = max(1, int(max_calibration_batches))

        # LL-FIX-03: safe device.
        if device is not None:
            self.target_device = torch.device(device)
        else:
            self.target_device = _get_device(model)

        # LL-FIX-15: initialize all lists in __init__.
        self.compressed_layers: list[str] = []
        self.fallback_layers: list[str] = []
        self.layer_errors: dict[str, float] = {}
        self.layer_details: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.stats: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self._compressed_params: int = 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Target check (LL-FIX-06)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _is_target_module(self, name: str, module: nn.Module, _debug: bool = False) -> bool:
        name_lower = name.lower()
        if any(part in name.split(".") for part in ("lora_A", "lora_B", "base_layer")):
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: lora/base_layer part")
            return False

        # Skip already-compressed.
        cls_name = module.__class__.__name__
        if cls_name in (
            "LSCPrunedLoRALinear",
            "DynamicSVDLinear",
            "SVDLinear",
            "FactorisedLinear",
            "LowRankPlusSparseLinear",
        ):
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: already compressed ({cls_name})")
            return False

        if any(
            skip in name_lower
            for skip in [
                "classifier",
                "score",
                "lm_head",
                "pooler",
                "embedding",
                "router",
                "gate",
            ]
        ):
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: skip keyword")
            return False

        target_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
        cls_lower = target_mod.__class__.__name__.lower()
        is_linear_like = (
            isinstance(target_mod, nn.Linear) or "conv1d" in cls_lower or hasattr(target_mod, "nf")
        )
        if not is_linear_like:
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: not linear-like")
            return False

        # LL-FIX-09: allow bypassing framework filter.
        if not self.skip_should_compress_filter:
            try:
                if not should_compress_linear(self.model, name):
                    if _debug:
                        logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: should_compress_linear=False")
                    return False
            except Exception as e:
                if _debug:
                    logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: should_compress_linear raised {e}")
                return False

        # LL-FIX-10: filter tiny layers.
        w = getattr(target_mod, "weight", None)
        if w is None:
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: weight None")
            return False
        if min(w.shape[0], w.shape[1]) < self.min_layer_dim:
            if _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: dim too small {tuple(w.shape)}")
            return False

        if self.target_attention_only:
            is_attn = any(k in name_lower for k in _ATTN_NAMES)
            if not is_attn:
                if _debug:
                    logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: not attention")
                return False

        if self.skip_attention:
            attn_keywords = {
                "query",
                "key",
                "value",
                "q_lin",
                "k_lin",
                "v_lin",
                "q_proj",
                "k_proj",
                "v_proj",
                "out_lin",
                "out_proj",
                "dense",
                "o_proj",
                "c_attn",
            }
            last = name.split(".")[-1].lower()
            if last in attn_keywords or any(k in name_lower for k in ("self_attn", "attn.c_attn")):
                if _debug:
                    logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: skip_attention")
                return False

        if self.target_modules is not None:
            ok = any(t in name for t in self.target_modules)
            if not ok and _debug:
                logger.info(f"  [skip] {name}: not in target_modules")
            return ok

        if _debug:
            logger.info(f"  [TARGET] {name}: shape={tuple(w.shape)}")
        return True

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # IO activation collection
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _collect_io_activations(
        self,
    ) -> dict[str, tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]]:
        """Collect input/output activations across target layers."""
        self.model.eval()
        activations: dict[str, dict[str, list[torch.Tensor]]] = {}
        hooks = []

        def make_hook(layer_name: str):
            def hook(module: nn.Module, inputs: tuple[Any, ...], output: Any):
                inp = inputs[0].detach() if inputs and isinstance(inputs[0], torch.Tensor) else None
                if isinstance(output, torch.Tensor):
                    out = output.detach()
                elif (
                    isinstance(output, (tuple, list))
                    and output
                    and isinstance(output[0], torch.Tensor)
                ):
                    out = output[0].detach()
                else:
                    out = None
                if inp is not None and out is not None:
                    if layer_name not in activations:
                        activations[layer_name] = {"in": [], "out": []}
                    activations[layer_name]["in"].append(inp.cpu())
                    activations[layer_name]["out"].append(out.cpu())

            return hook

        target_list = [
            (name, module)
            for name, module in self.model.named_modules()
            if self._is_target_module(name, module)
        ]
        if not target_list:
            return {}

        for name, module in target_list:
            hooks.append(module.register_forward_hook(make_hook(name)))

        try:
            calib_inputs = get_calibration_tensors(
                self.model,
                tokenizer=self.tokenizer,
                calibration_loader=self.calibration_loader,
                calibration_texts=self.calibration_texts,
                device=self.target_device,
            )
            batches = self._normalize_batches(calib_inputs)
            n_batches = min(len(batches), self.max_calibration_batches)
            with torch.no_grad():
                for i in range(n_batches):
                    batch = batches[i]
                    try:
                        if isinstance(batch, dict):
                            batch = {
                                k: (v.to(self.target_device) if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) else v)
                                for k, v in batch.items()
                            }
                            self.model(**batch)
                        elif isinstance(batch, torch.Tensor):
                            self.model(batch.to(self.target_device))
                        elif isinstance(batch, (list, tuple)):
                            batch = [
                                (v.to(self.target_device) if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) else v)
                                for v in batch
                            ]
                            self.model(*batch)
                    except Exception as e:
                        logger.debug("Calibration batch %d failed: %s", i, e)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("LiLLaMA: calibration forward raised: %s", e)
        finally:
            for h in hooks:
                h.remove()

        aggregated: dict[str, tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]] = {}
        MAX_ACTIVATION_SAMPLES = 512
        for name, data in activations.items():
            if data["in"] and data["out"]:
                try:
                    cat_in = torch.cat(data["in"], dim=0)
                    cat_out = torch.cat(data["out"], dim=0)
                    if cat_in.size(0) > MAX_ACTIVATION_SAMPLES:
                        cat_in = cat_in[:MAX_ACTIVATION_SAMPLES]
                        cat_out = cat_out[:MAX_ACTIVATION_SAMPLES]
                    aggregated[name] = (cat_in, cat_out)
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.debug("Activation concat failed for %s: %s", name, e)
        return aggregated

    @staticmethod
    def _normalize_batches(calib_inputs: Any) -> list[Any]:
        if calib_inputs is None:
            return []
        if isinstance(calib_inputs, torch.Tensor):
            return [calib_inputs]
        if isinstance(calib_inputs, dict):
            return [calib_inputs]
        if isinstance(calib_inputs, (list, tuple)):
            if len(calib_inputs) == 0:
                return []
            first = calib_inputs[0]
            if isinstance(first, (dict, torch.Tensor)):
                return list(calib_inputs)
            return [calib_inputs]
        return [calib_inputs]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SVD factorization helper
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _factorize(
        self,
        W: torch.Tensor,
        rank: int,
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, int]:
        """Return (W_recon, rank_used)."""
        try:
            U, S, Vh = torch.linalg.svd(W, full_matrices=False)
            total_energy = (S**2).sum().clamp(min=1e-12)
            cum_ratio = torch.cumsum(S**2, 0) / total_energy
            r = min(rank, len(S))
            cum_e = cum_ratio[r - 1].item() if r > 0 else 0.0
            if cum_e < 0.95:
                idx = torch.where(cum_ratio >= 0.95)[0]
                if len(idx) > 0:
                    r = min(int(idx[0].item()) + 1, len(S))
            W_recon = (U[:, :r] * S[:r].unsqueeze(0)) @ Vh[:r, :]
            return W_recon, r
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug("LiLLaMA SVD factorization failed: %s", e)
            return W, 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Main compress
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def compress(self, **kwargs: Any) -> tuple[nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
        # LL-FIX-08: idempotence.
        if getattr(self.model, "_lillama_compressed", False):
            logger.warning("LiLLaMA: model already compressed; skipping.")
            try:
                return self.model, self.get_compression_stats()
            except Exception:
                return self.model, {}

        self.compressed_layers = []
        self.fallback_layers = []
        self.layer_errors = {}
        self.layer_details = {}

        activations_map = self._collect_io_activations()
        logger.info("LiLLaMA: %d target activation sets collected.", len(activations_map))

        # LL-FIX-06: diagnostic if no targets.
        target_list = [
            (name, module)
            for name, module in self.model.named_modules()
            if self._is_target_module(name, module)
        ]
        if not target_list:
            logger.warning("LiLLaMA: no compressible layers found. Running diagnostic...")
            n_scanned = 0
            for name, module in self.model.named_modules():
                n_scanned += 1
                self._is_target_module(name, module, _debug=True)
            logger.warning("LiLLaMA diagnostic: %d modules scanned, 0 targets.", n_scanned)
            try:
                return self.model, self.get_compression_stats()
            except Exception:
                return self.model, {}

        logger.info("LiLLaMA: %d target layers identified.", len(target_list))

        total_orig_params = 0
        total_comp_params = 0

        # Deduplicated parameter accounting.
        seen_param_ids: set = set()
        count_param_ids: set = set()

        for p in self.model.parameters():
            if id(p) not in seen_param_ids:
                seen_param_ids.add(id(p))
                total_orig_params += p.numel()

        def _count_params_of(mod: nn.Module):
            nonlocal total_comp_params
            for p in mod.parameters(recurse=False):
                if id(p) not in count_param_ids:
                    count_param_ids.add(id(p))
                    total_comp_params += p.numel()

        for name, module in target_list:
            target_layer = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
            raw_w = target_layer.weight.data
            is_conv1d = _is_conv1d(target_layer)
            device = raw_w.device
            dtype = target_layer.weight.dtype

            W = raw_w.t().contiguous().clone().float() if is_conv1d else raw_w.clone().float()
            d_out, d_in = W.shape
            used_cross_cov = False
            r_used = self.rank

            # LL-FIX-04: initialize W_new to W (safe default).
            W_new = W

            if name in activations_map:
                inp, out = activations_map[name]
                try:
                    inp_flat = inp.reshape(-1, inp.shape[-1]).float()
                    out_flat = out.reshape(-1, out.shape[-1]).float()
                    if inp_flat.shape[-1] == d_in and out_flat.shape[-1] == d_out:
                        C = torch.matmul(out_flat.t().contiguous(), inp_flat) / max(
                            len(inp_flat), 1
                        )
                        W_new, r_used = self._factorize(C, self.rank)
                        used_cross_cov = True
                    else:
                        W_new, r_used = self._factorize(W, self.rank)
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.debug("Cross-covariance factorization failed for %s: %s", name, e)
                    W_new, r_used = self._factorize(W, self.rank)
            else:
                W_new, r_used = self._factorize(W, self.rank)

            norm_orig = torch.norm(W, p="fro")
            rel_err = (torch.norm(W - W_new, p="fro") / (norm_orig + 1e-8)).item()
            self.layer_errors[name] = rel_err

            if rel_err > self.max_error:
                logger.warning(
                    "LiLLaMA: err %.4f on %s > %.4f. %s",
                    rel_err,
                    name,
                    self.max_error,
                    (
                        "Keeping original."
                        if self.fallback_to_original
                        else "Proceeding with distilled weights."
                    ),
                )
                if self.fallback_to_original:
                    self.fallback_layers.append(name)
                    for p in module.parameters(recurse=False):
                        p.requires_grad = False
                    _count_params_of(module)
                    continue

            # Shape integrity check.
            final_w = W_new.t().contiguous() if is_conv1d else W_new
            if final_w.shape != target_layer.weight.shape:
                logger.warning(
                    "LiLLaMA: shape mismatch for %s: expected %s, got %s; skipping.",
                    name,
                    tuple(target_layer.weight.shape),
                    tuple(final_w.shape),
                )
                _count_params_of(module)
                continue

            target_layer.weight.data.copy_(final_w.to(dtype=dtype, device=device))
            target_layer.weight.requires_grad = False
            if getattr(target_layer, "bias", None) is not None:
                target_layer.bias.requires_grad = False

            # Preserve LoRA adapter trainability.
            if hasattr(module, "lora_A") and hasattr(module, "lora_B"):
                for attr in ("lora_A", "lora_B"):
                    p = getattr(module, attr, None)
                    if p is None:
                        continue
                    if hasattr(p, "weight"):
                        p.weight.requires_grad = True
                    elif isinstance(p, nn.Parameter):
                        p.requires_grad = True

            self.compressed_layers.append(name)
            _count_params_of(module)

            self.layer_details[name] = {
                "rank": int(r_used),
                "rel_error": float(rel_err),
                "used_cross_cov": bool(used_cross_cov),
                "shape": tuple(final_w.shape),
            }

        # LL-FIX-07: forward sanity check.
        forward_check_success = True
        try:
            with torch.no_grad():
                dummy = torch.randint(0, 100, (1, 8), device=self.target_device, dtype=torch.long)
                try:
                    self.model(input_ids=dummy, attention_mask=torch.ones_like(dummy))
                except Exception:
                    try:
                        self.model(dummy)
                    except Exception as e2:
                        logger.warning("LiLLaMA: forward check failed: %s", e2)
                        forward_check_success = False
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("LiLLaMA: forward check raised: %s", e)
            forward_check_success = False

        try:
            self._compressed_params = self._count_params(self.model)
        except Exception:
            self._compressed_params = sum(p.numel() for p in self.model.parameters())

        # LL-FIX-04: avg error only over compressed layers.
        compressed_errs = [
            self.layer_errors[n] for n in self.compressed_layers if n in self.layer_errors
        ]
        avg_err = sum(compressed_errs) / len(compressed_errs) if compressed_errs else 0.0
        eff_ratio = total_comp_params / max(1, total_orig_params)

        try:
            stats = self.get_compression_stats()
        except Exception:
            stats = {}

        stats.update(
            {
                "distilled_layers": len(self.compressed_layers),
                "compressed_layers": self.compressed_layers,
                "fallback_layers": self.fallback_layers,
                "num_compressed": len(self.compressed_layers),
                "num_fallback": len(self.fallback_layers),
                "rank": self.rank,
                "max_error": self.max_error,
                "fallback_to_original": self.fallback_to_original,
                "avg_reconstruction_error": avg_err,
                "layer_errors": self.layer_errors,
                "layer_details": self.layer_details,
                "effective_parameter_ratio": eff_ratio,
                "forward_check_success": forward_check_success,
                "method": "lillama_cross_covariance_svd",
                # LL-FIX-12: honest note.
                "note": (
                    "LiLLaMA rewrites weights in-place with the distilled reconstruction. "
                    "The dense weight keeps its full (out, in) shape; framework-level "
                    "compression_rate reads 1.0. Use effective_parameter_ratio for the "
                    "theoretical storage metric."
                ),
            }
        )
        self.stats = stats

        # LL-FIX-13: write stats onto model.
        try:
            if not hasattr(self.model, "compression_stats") or self.model.compression_stats is None:
                self.model.compression_stats = {}
            self.model.compression_stats.update(
                {
                    "num_compressed": len(self.compressed_layers),
                    "num_fallback": len(self.fallback_layers),
                    "compression_method": "lillama_cross_covariance_svd",
                    "effective_parameter_ratio": eff_ratio,
                    "avg_reconstruction_error": avg_err,
                }
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

        self.model._lillama_compressed = True
        logger.info(
            "LiLLaMA: %d distilled, %d fallback. Avg err %.4f, eff_param_ratio %.2fx.",
            len(self.compressed_layers),
            len(self.fallback_layers),
            avg_err,
            eff_ratio,
        )
        return self.model, stats

class LoRALinear(nn.Module):
    is_custom_attention: bool = False

    def __init__(
        self,
        in_features: int,
        out_features: int,
        bias: bool = True,
        lora_rank: int = 16,
        lora_alpha: float = 32.0,
        freeze_base: bool = False,
        device: torch.device | None = None,
        dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        factory_kwargs = {"device": device, "dtype": dtype}
        self.in_features = in_features
        self.out_features = out_features
        self.lora_rank = lora_rank
        self.lora_alpha = lora_alpha
        self.lora_scaling = (lora_alpha / lora_rank) if lora_rank > 0 else 1.0
        self.freeze_base = freeze_base

        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.empty((out_features, in_features), **factory_kwargs))
        if bias:
            self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(out_features, **factory_kwargs))
        else:
            self.register_parameter("bias", None)

        if self.lora_rank > 0:
            self.lora_A = nn.Parameter(torch.empty((lora_rank, in_features), **factory_kwargs))
            self.lora_B = nn.Parameter(torch.empty((out_features, lora_rank), **factory_kwargs))
        else:
            self.register_parameter("lora_A", None)
            self.register_parameter("lora_B", None)

        self.reset_parameters()
        if freeze_base:
            self.freeze_base_weights()

    def reset_parameters(self) -> None:
        nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.weight, a=math.sqrt(5))
        if self.bias is not None:
            fan_in, _ = nn.init._calculate_fan_in_and_fan_out(self.weight)
            bound = 1 / math.sqrt(fan_in) if fan_in > 0 else 0
            nn.init.uniform_(self.bias, -bound, bound)
        if self.lora_rank > 0 and self.lora_A is not None:
            nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.lora_A, a=math.sqrt(5))
            self.lora_A.requires_grad = True
        if self.lora_rank > 0 and self.lora_B is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(self.lora_B)
            self.lora_B.requires_grad = True

    def freeze_base_weights(self) -> None:
        self.weight.requires_grad = False
        if self.bias is not None:
            self.bias.requires_grad = False
        if self.lora_rank > 0 and self.lora_A is not None:
            self.lora_A.requires_grad = True
        if self.lora_rank > 0 and self.lora_B is not None:
            self.lora_B.requires_grad = True

    def unfreeze_base_weights(self) -> None:
        self.weight.requires_grad = True
        if self.bias is not None:
            self.bias.requires_grad = True

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        out = F.linear(x, self.weight, self.bias)
        if self.lora_rank > 0 and self.lora_A is not None and self.lora_B is not None:
            lora_out = F.linear(F.linear(x, self.lora_A), self.lora_B) * self.lora_scaling
            out = out + lora_out
        return out

Base class for all neural network modules.

Your models should also subclass this class.

Modules can also contain other Modules, allowing them to be nested in a tree structure. You can assign the submodules as regular attributes::

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(1, 20, 5)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(20, 20, 5)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = F.relu(self.conv1(x))
        return F.relu(self.conv2(x))

Submodules assigned in this way will be registered, and will also have their parameters converted when you call :meth:to, etc.

Note

As per the example above, an __init__() call to the parent class must be made before assignment on the child.

:ivar training: Boolean represents whether this module is in training or evaluation mode. :vartype training: bool

class LowRankCompressor(BaseCompressor):
    is_custom_attention: bool = True
    """
    SoKA Low-Rank Linear Compressor.
    Replaces dense nn.Linear and Conv1D layers with factorized LowRankLinear layers.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: nn.Module,
        rank: int = 8,
        energy_threshold: float | None = None,
        max_error: float = 0.5,
        target_attention_only: bool = False,
        fallback_to_original: bool = True,
        target_modules: list[str] | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(model, name="soka", **kwargs)
        cfg = kwargs.get("comp_config", kwargs.get("cfg"))
        if cfg is not None:
            rank = _cfg_get(cfg, "soka_rank", _cfg_get(cfg, "rank", rank))
            energy_threshold = _cfg_get(
                cfg, "soka_energy", _cfg_get(cfg, "energy_threshold", energy_threshold)
            )
            max_error = _cfg_get(cfg, "max_error", max_error)
            fallback_to_original = _cfg_get(cfg, "fallback_to_original", fallback_to_original)
            target_attention_only = _cfg_get(cfg, "target_attention_only", target_attention_only)

        self.rank = max(1, int(rank))
        self.energy_threshold = energy_threshold
        self.max_error = float(max_error)
        self.target_attention_only = bool(target_attention_only)
        self.fallback_to_original = bool(fallback_to_original)
        self.target_modules = target_modules
        self.compressed_layers: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.layer_errors: dict[str, float] = {}
        self.stats: dict[str, Any] = {}

    def _is_target_module(self, name: str, module: nn.Module) -> bool:
        name_l = name.lower()
        if any(k in name_l for k in ["classifier", "score", "lm_head", "pooler", "embedding"]):
            return False

        if self.target_attention_only:
            attn_keywords = [
                "attn",
                "attention",
                "q_proj",
                "k_proj",
                "v_proj",
                "o_proj",
                "c_attn",
                "c_proj",
                "query",
                "key",
                "value",
            ]
            if not any(k in name_l for k in attn_keywords):
                return False

        base_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
        cls_name = base_mod.__class__.__name__
        is_linear_like = (
            isinstance(base_mod, nn.Linear)
            or "conv1d" in cls_name.lower()
            or hasattr(base_mod, "nf")
        )
        if not is_linear_like:
            return False
        if isinstance(base_mod, LowRankLinear):
            return False
        if not should_compress_linear(self.model, name):
            return False
        if self.target_modules is None:
            return True
        return any(t in name for t in self.target_modules)

    def _select_rank(self, S: torch.Tensor, in_f: int, out_f: int) -> int:
        """Determines rank dynamically based on singular energy or fixed target, capped for true reduction."""
        param_cap = max(1, (in_f * out_f) // (in_f + out_f) - 1)
        max_r = min(len(S), param_cap)

        if self.energy_threshold is None:
            return max(1, min(self.rank, max_r))
        total_energy = torch.sum(S**2)
        if total_energy <= 0:
            return max(1, min(self.rank, max_r))
        cum_energy = torch.cumsum(S**2, dim=0) / total_energy
        idx = torch.where(cum_energy >= self.energy_threshold)[0]
        r = idx[0].item() if len(idx) > 0 else len(S)
        return max(1, min(r, max_r))

    def compress(self, **kwargs: Any) -> tuple[nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
        """Replaces target Linear and Conv1D modules with LowRankLinear."""
        self.compressed_layers = []
        self.layer_errors = {}

        linear_layers: list[tuple[str, nn.Module]] = []
        for name, module in self.model.named_modules():
            if self._is_target_module(name, module):
                linear_layers.append((name, module))

        if not linear_layers:
            logger.warning("SoKA: No compressible linear layers found.")
            return self.model, self.get_compression_stats()

        for name, module in linear_layers:
            base_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
            raw_w = base_mod.weight.data
            cls_name = base_mod.__class__.__name__
            is_conv1d = (
                "conv1d" in cls_name.lower()
                or hasattr(base_mod, "nf")
                or (
                    raw_w.ndim == 2
                    and hasattr(base_mod, "in_features")
                    and base_mod.in_features == raw_w.shape[0]
                    and raw_w.shape[0] < raw_w.shape[1]
                )
            )

            W = raw_w.t().contiguous().clone().float() if is_conv1d else raw_w.clone().float()
            device = raw_w.device
            dtype = raw_w.dtype
            d_out, d_in = W.shape

            try:
                U, S, Vh = torch.linalg.svd(W, full_matrices=False)
                r = self._select_rank(S, d_in, d_out)
                sqrt_S = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(S[:r], min=1e-12))

                new_layer = LowRankLinear(
                    in_features=d_in,
                    out_features=d_out,
                    rank=r,
                    bias=(base_mod.bias is not None),
                    device=device,
                    dtype=dtype,
                )

                # Assign factorized weights: W ≈ (U_r sqrt(S)) @ (sqrt(S) V_r^T)
                # U: [d_out, r], V: [d_in, r]
                new_layer.U.data = (U[:, :r] * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0)).to(dtype=dtype, device=device)
                new_layer.V.data = (Vh[:r, :].T * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0)).to(
                    dtype=dtype, device=device
                )

                if base_mod.bias is not None:
                    new_layer.bias.data.copy_(base_mod.bias.data)

                # Frobenius reconstruction error check
                W_rec = new_layer.weight.float()
                norm_orig = torch.norm(W, p="fro")
                rel_err = (torch.norm(W - W_rec, p="fro") / (norm_orig + 1e-8)).item()
                self.layer_errors[name] = rel_err

                if self.fallback_to_original and rel_err > self.max_error:
                    logger.warning(
                        "SoKA reconstruction error %.4f on %s exceeded threshold %.4f. Skipping.",
                        rel_err,
                        name,
                        self.max_error,
                    )
                    for p in module.parameters():
                        p.requires_grad = False
                    continue

                compressed_layer = new_layer
                # Preserve existing LoRA adapter weights if the source module has them
                if (
                    hasattr(module, "lora_A")
                    and hasattr(module, "lora_B")
                    and module.lora_A is not None
                    and module.lora_B is not None
                ):
                    src_lA = getattr(module.lora_A, "weight", module.lora_A)
                    src_lB = getattr(module.lora_B, "weight", module.lora_B)
                    if hasattr(new_layer, "lora_A") and new_layer.lora_A is not None:
                        if hasattr(src_lA, "data") and src_lA.shape == new_layer.lora_A.shape:
                            new_layer.lora_A.data.copy_(src_lA.data)
                    if hasattr(new_layer, "lora_B") and new_layer.lora_B is not None:
                        if hasattr(src_lB, "data") and src_lB.shape == new_layer.lora_B.shape:
                            new_layer.lora_B.data.copy_(src_lB.data)

                if hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                    module.base_layer = compressed_layer  # put compressed layer inside wrapper
                    # module itself (LoRALinear wrapper) remains the replacement
                    new_module = module
                else:
                    new_module = compressed_layer
                if not hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                    if name == "":
                        self.model = new_module
                    else:
                        replace_module(self.model, name, new_module)
                self.compressed_layers.append(
                    {
                        "name": name,
                        "original_shape": (d_out, d_in),
                        "rank": r,
                        "error": rel_err,
                    }
                )
            except Exception as e:
                logger.debug("SVD decomposition error in %s: %s", name, e)
                for p in module.parameters():
                    p.requires_grad = False

        self._compressed_params = self._count_params(self.model)
        stats = self.get_compression_stats()
        stats.update(
            {
                "total_layers": len(self.compressed_layers),
                "method": "soka_low_rank_svd",
                "fixed_rank": self.rank,
                "energy_threshold": self.energy_threshold,
                "layer_errors": self.layer_errors,
                "target_attention_only": self.target_attention_only,
                "fallback_to_original": self.fallback_to_original,
                "max_error": self.max_error,
            }
        )
        self.stats = stats
        return self.model, stats

def compress(self, **kwargs: Any) -> tuple[nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
    """Replaces target Linear and Conv1D modules with LowRankLinear."""
    self.compressed_layers = []
    self.layer_errors = {}

    linear_layers: list[tuple[str, nn.Module]] = []
    for name, module in self.model.named_modules():
        if self._is_target_module(name, module):
            linear_layers.append((name, module))

    if not linear_layers:
        logger.warning("SoKA: No compressible linear layers found.")
        return self.model, self.get_compression_stats()

    for name, module in linear_layers:
        base_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
        raw_w = base_mod.weight.data
        cls_name = base_mod.__class__.__name__
        is_conv1d = (
            "conv1d" in cls_name.lower()
            or hasattr(base_mod, "nf")
            or (
                raw_w.ndim == 2
                and hasattr(base_mod, "in_features")
                and base_mod.in_features == raw_w.shape[0]
                and raw_w.shape[0] < raw_w.shape[1]
            )
        )

        W = raw_w.t().contiguous().clone().float() if is_conv1d else raw_w.clone().float()
        device = raw_w.device
        dtype = raw_w.dtype
        d_out, d_in = W.shape

        try:
            U, S, Vh = torch.linalg.svd(W, full_matrices=False)
            r = self._select_rank(S, d_in, d_out)
            sqrt_S = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(S[:r], min=1e-12))

            new_layer = LowRankLinear(
                in_features=d_in,
                out_features=d_out,
                rank=r,
                bias=(base_mod.bias is not None),
                device=device,
                dtype=dtype,
            )

            # Assign factorized weights: W ≈ (U_r sqrt(S)) @ (sqrt(S) V_r^T)
            # U: [d_out, r], V: [d_in, r]
            new_layer.U.data = (U[:, :r] * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0)).to(dtype=dtype, device=device)
            new_layer.V.data = (Vh[:r, :].T * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0)).to(
                dtype=dtype, device=device
            )

            if base_mod.bias is not None:
                new_layer.bias.data.copy_(base_mod.bias.data)

            # Frobenius reconstruction error check
            W_rec = new_layer.weight.float()
            norm_orig = torch.norm(W, p="fro")
            rel_err = (torch.norm(W - W_rec, p="fro") / (norm_orig + 1e-8)).item()
            self.layer_errors[name] = rel_err

            if self.fallback_to_original and rel_err > self.max_error:
                logger.warning(
                    "SoKA reconstruction error %.4f on %s exceeded threshold %.4f. Skipping.",
                    rel_err,
                    name,
                    self.max_error,
                )
                for p in module.parameters():
                    p.requires_grad = False
                continue

            compressed_layer = new_layer
            # Preserve existing LoRA adapter weights if the source module has them
            if (
                hasattr(module, "lora_A")
                and hasattr(module, "lora_B")
                and module.lora_A is not None
                and module.lora_B is not None
            ):
                src_lA = getattr(module.lora_A, "weight", module.lora_A)
                src_lB = getattr(module.lora_B, "weight", module.lora_B)
                if hasattr(new_layer, "lora_A") and new_layer.lora_A is not None:
                    if hasattr(src_lA, "data") and src_lA.shape == new_layer.lora_A.shape:
                        new_layer.lora_A.data.copy_(src_lA.data)
                if hasattr(new_layer, "lora_B") and new_layer.lora_B is not None:
                    if hasattr(src_lB, "data") and src_lB.shape == new_layer.lora_B.shape:
                        new_layer.lora_B.data.copy_(src_lB.data)

            if hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                module.base_layer = compressed_layer  # put compressed layer inside wrapper
                # module itself (LoRALinear wrapper) remains the replacement
                new_module = module
            else:
                new_module = compressed_layer
            if not hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                if name == "":
                    self.model = new_module
                else:
                    replace_module(self.model, name, new_module)
            self.compressed_layers.append(
                {
                    "name": name,
                    "original_shape": (d_out, d_in),
                    "rank": r,
                    "error": rel_err,
                }
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug("SVD decomposition error in %s: %s", name, e)
            for p in module.parameters():
                p.requires_grad = False

    self._compressed_params = self._count_params(self.model)
    stats = self.get_compression_stats()
    stats.update(
        {
            "total_layers": len(self.compressed_layers),
            "method": "soka_low_rank_svd",
            "fixed_rank": self.rank,
            "energy_threshold": self.energy_threshold,
            "layer_errors": self.layer_errors,
            "target_attention_only": self.target_attention_only,
            "fallback_to_original": self.fallback_to_original,
            "max_error": self.max_error,
        }
    )
    self.stats = stats
    return self.model, stats
