@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("saes_svd_v2")
@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("saes_svd_compressor")
@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("saes_svd")
@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("saes")
class SAESSVDCompressorV2(BaseCompressor):
    is_custom_attention: bool = True
    """
    SAES-SVD v2 Compressor with iterative spectrum-aware residual correction,
    Frobenius validation, and safe fallback.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: nn.Module,
        rank: int | None = None,
        rank_ratio: float = 0.5,
        correcting_steps: int = 2,
        target_modules: list[str] | None = None,
        target_attention_only: bool = False,
        max_error: float = 0.60,
        fallback_to_original: bool = True,  # Fix 1: Default changed to True
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(model, name="saes_svd_v2", **kwargs)
        cfg = kwargs.get("comp_config", kwargs.get("cfg"))
        if cfg is not None:
            rank = _cfg_get(cfg, "saes_rank", _cfg_get(cfg, "rank", rank))
            rank_ratio = _cfg_get(cfg, "saes_rank_ratio", _cfg_get(cfg, "rank_ratio", rank_ratio))
            correcting_steps = _cfg_get(cfg, "correcting_steps", correcting_steps)
            max_error = _cfg_get(cfg, "max_error", max_error)
            fallback_to_original = _cfg_get(cfg, "fallback_to_original", fallback_to_original)
            target_attention_only = _cfg_get(cfg, "target_attention_only", target_attention_only)

        if "rank" in kwargs and kwargs["rank"] is not None:
            rank = kwargs["rank"]
        if "fallback_to_original" in kwargs:
            fallback_to_original = bool(kwargs["fallback_to_original"])

        self.rank = rank
        self.rank_ratio = float(rank_ratio)
        self.correcting_steps = int(correcting_steps)
        self.target_modules = target_modules
        self.target_attention_only = bool(target_attention_only)
        self.max_error = float(max_error)
        self.fallback_to_original = bool(fallback_to_original)
        self.layer_errors: dict[str, float] = {}
        self.layer_ranks: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.replaced_layers: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def _is_target_module(self, name: str, module: nn.Module) -> bool:
        """
        Fix 6: Unified critical-layer protection delegated to should_compress_linear.
        """
        name_l = name.lower()
        if self.target_attention_only:
            attn_keywords = [
                "attn",
                "attention",
                "q_proj",
                "k_proj",
                "v_proj",
                "o_proj",
                "c_attn",
                "c_proj",
                "query",
                "key",
                "value",
            ]
            if not any(k in name_l for k in attn_keywords):
                return False

        base_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
        cls_name = base_mod.__class__.__name__.lower()
        # Fix 3: Reliable Conv1D check using class name and hasattr(nf)
        is_linear_like = (
            isinstance(base_mod, nn.Linear) or "conv1d" in cls_name or hasattr(base_mod, "nf")
        )
        if not is_linear_like:
            return False
        if isinstance(base_mod, SVDLinear):
            return False
        if not should_compress_linear(self.model, name):
            return False
        if self.target_modules is None:
            return True
        return any(t in name for t in self.target_modules)

    def compress_linear(
        self,
        layer: nn.Module,
        rank: int | None = None,
        name: str = "",
    ) -> SVDLinear | None:
        """Decompose a single linear or Conv1D layer with spectrum-aware error suppression."""
        base_layer = getattr(layer, "base_layer", layer)
        raw_w = base_layer.weight.data
        cls_name = base_layer.__class__.__name__.lower()
        # Fix 3: Conv1D detection by class name or nf attribute
        is_conv1d = "conv1d" in cls_name or hasattr(base_layer, "nf")

        if is_conv1d:
            W = raw_w.t().contiguous().float()
            out_f = W.shape[0]
            in_f = W.shape[1]
        else:
            W = raw_w.float()
            out_f = getattr(base_layer, "out_features", W.shape[0])
            in_f = getattr(base_layer, "in_features", W.shape[1])

        max_r = min(out_f, in_f)
        # Cap rank to guarantee parameter reduction
        param_cap = max(1, (in_f * out_f) // (in_f + out_f) - 1)
        effective_max_r = min(max_r, param_cap)

        if rank is not None:
            r = max(1, min(rank, effective_max_r))
        else:
            r = max(1, min(int(round(max_r * self.rank_ratio)), effective_max_r))

        device = base_layer.weight.device
        dtype = base_layer.weight.dtype

        # Compute full SVD in FP32
        try:
            U, S, Vt = torch.linalg.svd(W, full_matrices=False)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("SAES-SVD SVD failure for %s: %s", name, e)
            return None

        # Initial symmetric square-root singular value allocation
        sqrt_S = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(S[:r], min=1e-12))
        A = U[:, :r] * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0)  # [out_features, r]
        B = sqrt_S.unsqueeze(1) * Vt[:r, :]  # [r, in_features]

        # Iterative residual error suppression
        eps_eye = 1e-6 * torch.eye(r, device=W.device, dtype=torch.float32)
        for _ in range(self.correcting_steps):
            E = W - A @ B
            # Update A towards residual gradient
            BBt = B @ B.t().contiguous() + eps_eye
            A = A + E @ B.t().contiguous() @ torch.linalg.pinv(BBt)

            # Update B towards residual gradient
            AtA = A.t().contiguous() @ A + eps_eye
            B = B + torch.linalg.pinv(AtA) @ A.t().contiguous() @ (W - A @ B)

        # Compute relative Frobenius reconstruction error
        W_rec = A @ B
        norm_orig = torch.norm(W, p="fro")
        rel_err = (torch.norm(W - W_rec, p="fro") / (norm_orig + 1e-8)).item()

        # Fix 2: Always log a warning when reconstruction error exceeds max_error
        if rel_err > self.max_error:
            logger.warning(
                "SAES-SVD reconstruction error %.4f on %s exceeded threshold %.4f%s",
                rel_err,
                name,
                self.max_error,
                (
                    ". Keeping original layer."
                    if self.fallback_to_original
                    else ". Proceeding with compressed layer."
                ),
            )
            if self.fallback_to_original:
                return None

        has_bias = getattr(base_layer, "bias", None) is not None
        has_lora = hasattr(layer, "lora_A") and hasattr(layer, "lora_B")
        lora_r = getattr(layer, "r", 0) if has_lora else 0

        svd_layer = SVDLinear(
            in_features=in_f,
            out_features=out_f,
            rank=r,
            bias=has_bias,
            dtype=dtype,
            device=device,
            lora_r=lora_r,
        )
        svd_layer.set_low_rank_factors(
            U_factor=A.to(dtype=dtype, device=device),
            V_factor=B.to(dtype=dtype, device=device),
        )
        # Fix 5: Ensure bias is copied correctly for both Linear and Conv1D
        if has_bias and svd_layer.bias is not None:
            svd_layer.bias.data.copy_(base_layer.bias.data.to(dtype=dtype, device=device))

        if has_lora and svd_layer.use_lora:
            try:
                if hasattr(layer.lora_A, "weight"):
                    svd_layer.lora_A.weight.data.copy_(layer.lora_A.weight.data)
                if hasattr(layer.lora_B, "weight"):
                    svd_layer.lora_B.weight.data.copy_(layer.lora_B.weight.data)
            except Exception as e_lora:
                logger.warning("Could not preserve LoRA adapters in SAES-SVD: %s", e_lora)

        # Store metadata on module
        svd_layer.reconstruction_error = rel_err
        svd_layer.rank = r
        return svd_layer

    def compress(self) -> tuple[nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
        """Compress all linear and Conv1D layers in the model."""
        self.layer_errors = {}
        self.layer_ranks = {}
        self.replaced_layers = []

        target_layers = [
            (name, mod)
            for name, mod in self.model.named_modules()
            if self._is_target_module(name, mod)
        ]

        if not target_layers:
            logger.warning("SAES-SVD v2: No compressible linear layers found.")
            return self.model, self.get_compression_stats()

        for name, module in target_layers:
            svd_layer = self.compress_linear(module, rank=self.rank, name=name)
            if svd_layer is not None:
                err = getattr(svd_layer, "reconstruction_error", 0.0)
                r = getattr(svd_layer, "rank", self.rank)
                self.layer_errors[name] = err
                self.layer_ranks[name] = r
                # Fix 4: Include per-layer rank and error in returned stats
                self.replaced_layers.append({"name": name, "rank": r, "error": err})
                replace_module(self.model, name, svd_layer)
            else:
                for p in module.parameters():
                    p.requires_grad = False

        self._compressed_params = self._count_params(self.model)
        stats = self.get_compression_stats()
        # Fix 4 & Fix 6: Detailed per-layer stats, errors, ranks, and fallback status
        stats.update(
            {
                "layer_errors": self.layer_errors,
                "layer_ranks": self.layer_ranks,
                "replaced_layers": self.replaced_layers,
                "compressed_layers": len(self.replaced_layers),
                "max_error": self.max_error,
                "fallback_to_original": self.fallback_to_original,
                "correcting_steps": self.correcting_steps,
                "target_attention_only": self.target_attention_only,
            }
        )
        return self.model, stats

@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("salr")
class SALRCompressor(BaseCompressor):
    is_custom_attention: bool = True
    """
    SALR Compressor: Structure-Aware Low-Rank and Sparse Pruning.

    Factorizes dense nn.Linear or Conv1D layers into symmetric low-rank factors
    (U * sqrt(Sigma), sqrt(Sigma) * V^T) and applies structured sparse pruning
    to trailing singular components in the bottleneck with LoRA adapters for recovery.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: nn.Module,
        rank: int = 64,
        sparsity: float = 0.5,
        min_rank: int = 8,
        skip_attention_qkv: bool = False,
        target_attention_only: bool = False,
        use_lora: bool = False,
        lora_r: int = 0,
        lora_alpha: float = 1.0,
        target_modules: list[str] | None = None,
        max_error: float = 0.50,
        fallback_to_original: bool = True,
        min_numel: int = 16,
        device: str | torch.device | None = None,
        cfg: Any | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(model, name="salr", **kwargs)
        cfg_obj = cfg or kwargs.get("comp_config")

        if "rank" in kwargs and kwargs["rank"] is not None:
            rank = kwargs["rank"]
        elif cfg_obj is not None:
            rank = _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "salr_rank", _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "rank", rank))

        self.rank = int(rank)
        self.sparsity = max(
            0.0,
            min(
                float(
                    sparsity
                    or _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "salr_sparsity", _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "sparsity", 0.5))
                ),
                0.90,
            ),
        )
        self.min_rank = max(1, int(min_rank or _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "min_rank", 8)))
        self.skip_attention_qkv = bool(
            skip_attention_qkv
            if skip_attention_qkv is not None
            else _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "skip_attention_qkv", False)
        )
        self.target_attention_only = bool(
            target_attention_only
            if target_attention_only is not None
            else _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "target_attention_only", False)
        )
        self.use_lora = bool(use_lora or _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "use_lora", False) or (lora_r > 0))
        self.lora_r = int(lora_r or _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "lora_r", 0))
        self.lora_alpha = float(lora_alpha or _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "lora_alpha", 1.0))
        self.target_modules = target_modules
        self.max_error = float(max_error or _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "max_error", 0.50))
        self.fallback_to_original = bool(
            fallback_to_original
            if fallback_to_original is not None
            else _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "fallback_to_original", True)
        )
        self.min_numel = max(1, int(min_numel or _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "min_numel", 16)))

        # Target device derivation
        if device is not None:
            try:
                self.target_device = torch.device(device)
            except Exception:
                self.target_device = (
                    next(model.parameters()).device
                    if list(model.parameters())
                    else torch.device("cpu")
                )
        else:
            self.target_device = (
                next(model.parameters()).device if list(model.parameters()) else torch.device("cpu")
            )

        # Diagnostics & Tracking
        self.visited_modules: set[int] = set()
        self.compressed_layers: list[str] = []
        self.protected_layers: list[str] = []
        self.skipped_layers: list[str] = []
        self.fallback_layers: list[str] = []
        self.failed_layers: list[str] = []
        self.layer_errors: dict[str, float] = {}
        self.replaced_layers: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def _is_gqa_asymmetric(self, name: str, module: nn.Module) -> bool:
        """Check if layer belongs to an attention projection in a GQA architecture."""
        cfg = getattr(self.model, "config", None)
        num_heads = getattr(cfg, "num_attention_heads", None)
        num_kv_heads = getattr(cfg, "num_key_value_heads", None)
        is_gqa = num_heads is not None and num_kv_heads is not None and num_kv_heads < num_heads

        name_l = name.lower()
        is_attn_qkv = any(
            p in name_l
            for p in [
                "q_proj",
                "k_proj",
                "v_proj",
                "c_attn",
                "query",
                "key",
                "value",
                "q_lin",
                "k_lin",
                "v_lin",
                "self_attn.q",
                "self_attn.k",
                "self_attn.v",
            ]
        )
        return (is_gqa or self.skip_attention_qkv) and is_attn_qkv

    def _is_target_module(self, name: str, module: nn.Module) -> bool:
        name_l = name.lower()
        # 1. Protection for critical / classification / head / pooler / embedding layers
        if any(
            k in name_l
            for k in [
                "classifier",
                "score",
                "lm_head",
                "pooler",
                "embed",
                "embedding",
                "cls_head",
                "head",
                "logits_processor",
            ]
        ):
            self.protected_layers.append(name)
            return False

        # Target attention only filter
        if self.target_attention_only:
            attn_keywords = [
                "attn",
                "attention",
                "q_proj",
                "k_proj",
                "v_proj",
                "o_proj",
                "c_attn",
                "c_proj",
                "query",
                "key",
                "value",
            ]
            if not any(k in name_l for k in attn_keywords):
                return False

        # 2. GQA-aware skipping
        if self._is_gqa_asymmetric(name, module):
            self.skipped_layers.append(name)
            return False

        # 3. Check linear or Conv1D nature
        base_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
        cls_name = base_mod.__class__.__name__
        raw_w = getattr(base_mod, "weight", None)
        if raw_w is None or not isinstance(raw_w, torch.Tensor):
            return False

        is_conv1d = "conv1d" in cls_name.lower() or hasattr(base_mod, "nf")
        is_linear_like = isinstance(base_mod, nn.Linear) or is_conv1d
        if not is_linear_like or isinstance(base_mod, SALRLayer):
            return False

        # 4. Tiny layer guard
        if raw_w.numel() < self.min_numel:
            self.skipped_layers.append(name)
            return False

        # 5. Respect framework compatibility rules
        if not should_compress_linear(self.model, name):
            self.protected_layers.append(name)
            return False

        # 6. User-defined explicit target modules
        if self.target_modules is not None:
            return any(t in name for t in self.target_modules)
        return True

    def compress_linear(
        self,
        layer: nn.Module,
        rank: int,
    ) -> SALRLayer | None:
        """Decompose a single linear or Conv1D layer into SALRLayer with validation."""
        base_layer = getattr(layer, "base_layer", layer)
        raw_w = base_layer.weight.data
        cls_name = base_layer.__class__.__name__
        is_conv1d = "conv1d" in cls_name.lower() or hasattr(base_layer, "nf")

        if is_conv1d:
            W = raw_w.t().contiguous().float()
            out_f, in_f = W.shape
        else:
            W = raw_w.contiguous().float()
            out_f = getattr(base_layer, "out_features", W.shape[0])
            in_f = getattr(base_layer, "in_features", W.shape[1])

        max_r = min(out_f, in_f)
        param_cap = max(1, (in_f * out_f) // (in_f + out_f) - 1)
        r = max(self.min_rank, min(rank, max_r - 1, param_cap))
        if r >= max_r:
            logger.debug(
                "SALR: rank %d >= max_r %d; skipping layer for no parameter reduction",
                r,
                max_r,
            )
            return None

        device = base_layer.weight.device
        dtype = base_layer.weight.dtype

        # SVD in FP32
        try:
            U, S, Vt = torch.linalg.svd(W, full_matrices=False)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("SALR SVD decomposition failure: %s", e)
            return None

        sqrt_S = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(S[:r], min=1e-12))
        U_r = (U[:, :r] * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0)).to(dtype=dtype, device=device)
        V_r = (sqrt_S.unsqueeze(1) * Vt[:r, :]).to(dtype=dtype, device=device)

        has_existing_lora = hasattr(layer, "lora_A") and hasattr(layer, "lora_B")
        effective_lora_r = self.lora_r
        if has_existing_lora and getattr(layer, "r", 0) > 0:
            effective_lora_r = getattr(layer, "r", self.lora_r)

        salr_layer = SALRLayer(
            in_features=in_f,
            out_features=out_f,
            rank=r,
            sparsity=self.sparsity,
            bias=base_layer.bias is not None,
            dtype=dtype,
            device=device,
            lora_r=effective_lora_r if (self.use_lora or has_existing_lora) else 0,
            lora_alpha=self.lora_alpha,
        )
        salr_layer.set_low_rank_factors(U_r, V_r)
        if base_layer.bias is not None:
            salr_layer.bias.data.copy_(base_layer.bias.data)

        # Preserve existing LoRA adapters
        if has_existing_lora and salr_layer.lora_r > 0:
            try:
                if hasattr(layer.lora_A, "weight") and salr_layer.lora_A is not None:
                    salr_layer.lora_A.data.copy_(layer.lora_A.weight.data)
                elif (
                    hasattr(layer, "lora_A")
                    and isinstance(layer.lora_A, torch.Tensor)
                    and salr_layer.lora_A is not None
                ):
                    salr_layer.lora_A.data.copy_(layer.lora_A.data)
                if hasattr(layer.lora_B, "weight") and salr_layer.lora_B is not None:
                    salr_layer.lora_B.data.copy_(layer.lora_B.weight.data)
                elif (
                    hasattr(layer, "lora_B")
                    and isinstance(layer.lora_B, torch.Tensor)
                    and salr_layer.lora_B is not None
                ):
                    salr_layer.lora_B.data.copy_(layer.lora_B.data)
            except Exception as e_lora:
                logger.warning("Could not copy existing LoRA adapters: %s", e_lora)

        # Frobenius reconstruction error check
        W_rec = salr_layer.weight.float()
        norm_orig = torch.norm(W, p="fro").clamp_min(1e-8)
        rel_err = (torch.norm(W - W_rec, p="fro") / norm_orig).item()

        is_invalid = torch.isnan(W_rec).any() or torch.isinf(W_rec).any()
        if rel_err > self.max_error:
            logger.warning(
                "SALR: reconstruction error %.4f exceeded threshold %.4f.",
                rel_err,
                self.max_error,
            )
            is_invalid = True

        if is_invalid and self.fallback_to_original:
            return None

        salr_layer.reconstruction_error = rel_err
        return salr_layer

    def compress(self, **kwargs: Any) -> tuple[nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
        """Compress all linear layers in the model."""
        self.layer_errors = {}
        self.replaced_layers = []
        self.visited_modules.clear()
        self.compressed_layers.clear()
        self.protected_layers.clear()
        self.skipped_layers.clear()
        self.fallback_layers.clear()
        self.failed_layers.clear()

        target_layers = [
            (name, mod)
            for name, mod in self.model.named_modules()
            if self._is_target_module(name, mod)
        ]

        if not target_layers:
            logger.warning("SALR: No compressible linear layers found.")
            return self.model, self.get_compression_stats()

        for name, module in target_layers:
            mod_id = id(module)
            if mod_id in self.visited_modules:
                logger.debug("SALR: Skipping tied module %s", name)
                self.skipped_layers.append(name)
                continue
            self.visited_modules.add(mod_id)

            try:
                new_layer = self.compress_linear(module, rank=self.rank)
                if new_layer is not None:
                    err = getattr(new_layer, "reconstruction_error", 0.0)
                    self.layer_errors[name] = err
                    self.replaced_layers.append(
                        {"name": name, "rank": new_layer.rank, "error": err}
                    )
                    replace_module(self.model, name, new_layer)
                    self.compressed_layers.append(name)
                else:
                    self.fallback_layers.append(name)
                    for p in module.parameters():
                        p.requires_grad = False
            except Exception as e_comp:
                logger.warning("Failed to compress %s: %s", name, e_comp)
                self.failed_layers.append(name)
                for p in module.parameters():
                    p.requires_grad = False

        # Post-compression forward sanity check
        forward_check_success = True
        try:
            with torch.no_grad():
                dummy_input = torch.randint(0, 100, (1, 8), device=self.target_device)
                self.model(dummy_input)
        except Exception as ex_sanity:
            logger.warning("SALR post-compression forward sanity check warning: %s", ex_sanity)
            forward_check_success = False

        self._compressed_params = self._count_params(self.model)
        avg_err = (
            (sum(self.layer_errors.values()) / len(self.layer_errors)) if self.layer_errors else 0.0
        )
        stats = self.get_compression_stats()
        stats.update(
            {
                "compressed_layers": self.compressed_layers,
                "compressed_layer_count": len(self.compressed_layers),
                "protected_layers": self.protected_layers,
                "protected_layer_count": len(self.protected_layers),
                "skipped_layers": self.skipped_layers,
                "skipped_layer_count": len(self.skipped_layers),
                "fallback_layers": self.fallback_layers,
                "fallback_layer_count": len(self.fallback_layers),
                "failed_layers": self.failed_layers,
                "failed_layer_count": len(self.failed_layers),
                "layer_errors": self.layer_errors,
                "avg_reconstruction_error": avg_err,
                "forward_check_success": forward_check_success,
                "rank": self.rank,
                "min_rank": self.min_rank,
                "sparsity": self.sparsity,
                "skip_attention_qkv": self.skip_attention_qkv,
                "target_attention_only": self.target_attention_only,
                "use_lora": self.use_lora,
                "lora_r": self.lora_r,
                "method": "salr",
            }
        )
        self.stats = stats
        return self.model, stats

Base class for all compressors. Not a nn.Module to avoid parameter storage.

var is_custom_attention : bool

SALR Compressor: Structure-Aware Low-Rank and Sparse Pruning.

Factorizes dense nn.Linear or Conv1D layers into symmetric low-rank factors (U * sqrt(Sigma), sqrt(Sigma) * V^T) and applies structured sparse pruning to trailing singular components in the bottleneck with LoRA adapters for recovery.

class SALRLayer(nn.Module):
    """
    Structure-Aware Low-Rank + Sparse Layer (SALR).

    Combines truncated SVD rank reduction with sparse singular component selection
    and optional trainable LoRA fine-tuning adapters:
        y = (x @ (V * mask).T) @ U.T + bias + (lora_B @ lora_A @ x) * scaling
    where U: [out_features, rank], V: [rank, in_features], mask: [rank, 1].
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        in_features: int,
        out_features: int,
        rank: int,
        sparsity: float = 0.5,
        bias: bool = True,
        dtype: torch.dtype = torch.float32,
        device: torch.device | None = None,
        lora_r: int = 0,
        lora_alpha: float = 1.0,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.in_features = in_features
        self.out_features = out_features
        self.rank = max(1, min(rank, in_features, out_features))
        self.sparsity = max(0.0, min(float(sparsity), 0.90))
        self.lora_r = int(lora_r)
        self.lora_alpha = float(lora_alpha)
        self.scaling = (self.lora_alpha / self.lora_r) if self.lora_r > 0 else 1.0

        requires_grad = not (self.lora_r > 0)
        self.V = nn.Parameter(
            torch.empty(self.rank, in_features, dtype=dtype, device=device),
            requires_grad=requires_grad,
        )
        self.U = nn.Parameter(
            torch.empty(out_features, self.rank, dtype=dtype, device=device),
            requires_grad=requires_grad,
        )

        if bias:
            self.bias = nn.Parameter(
                torch.empty(out_features, dtype=dtype, device=device),
                requires_grad=requires_grad,
            )
        else:
            self.register_parameter("bias", None)

        # 1D binary mask on singular bottleneck components: [rank, 1]
        mask = torch.ones(self.rank, 1, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
        if 0.0 < self.sparsity < 1.0:
            num_zeros = int(round(self.rank * self.sparsity))
            if num_zeros > 0:
                mask[-num_zeros:, :] = 0.0
        self.register_buffer("mask", mask)

        if self.lora_r > 0:
            self.lora_A = nn.Parameter(
                torch.empty((self.lora_r, in_features), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
            )
            self.lora_B = nn.Parameter(
                torch.zeros((out_features, self.lora_r), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
            )
            nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.lora_A, a=math.sqrt(5))
        else:
            self.register_parameter("lora_A", None)
            self.register_parameter("lora_B", None)

        self.reset_parameters()

    def reset_parameters(self) -> None:
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.U)
        nn.init.orthogonal_(self.V)
        if self.bias is not None:
            nn.init.zeros_(self.bias)

    def set_low_rank_factors(self, U_factor: torch.Tensor, V_factor: torch.Tensor) -> None:
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.U.copy_(U_factor)
            self.V.copy_(V_factor)

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Two-stage forward pass with sparse bottleneck mask and optional LoRA branch."""
        V_masked = self.V * self.mask.to(dtype=self.V.dtype)
        latent = F.linear(x, V_masked)  # [..., rank]
        out = F.linear(latent, self.U, self.bias)  # [..., out_features]

        if self.lora_r > 0 and self.lora_A is not None and self.lora_B is not None:
            lora_out = F.linear(F.linear(x.float(), self.lora_A), self.lora_B) * self.scaling
            out = out + lora_out.to(out.dtype)
        return out

    @property
    def weight(self) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Effective reconstructed weight matrix."""
        V_masked = self.V * self.mask.to(dtype=self.V.dtype)
        return torch.matmul(self.U, V_masked)

    def extra_repr(self) -> str:
        return f"in_features={self.in_features}, out_features={self.out_features}, rank={self.rank}, sparsity={self.sparsity}, lora_r={self.lora_r}"

Structure-Aware Low-Rank + Sparse Layer (SALR).

Combines truncated SVD rank reduction with sparse singular component selection and optional trainable LoRA fine-tuning adapters: y = (x @ (V * mask).T) @ U.T + bias + (lora_B @ lora_A @ x) * scaling where U: [out_features, rank], V: [rank, in_features], mask: [rank, 1].

@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("sdrm_class")
@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("sdrm_compressor_class")
class SDRMCompressor(BaseCompressor):
    is_custom_attention: bool = True
    """
    SDRM: Scaled Dimension Rank Modulation.
    Assigns layer rank proportional to parameter budget for edge inference and factorizes
    target layers into low-rank SVDLinear modules with optional LoRA fine-tuning adapters.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: nn.Module,
        total_param_ratio: float = 0.7,
        min_rank: int = 8,
        skip_attention_qkv: bool = False,
        target_attention_only: bool = False,
        use_lora: bool = False,
        lora_r: int = 0,
        lora_alpha: float = 1.0,
        target_modules: list[str] | None = None,
        max_error: float = 0.50,
        fallback_to_original: bool = True,
        min_numel: int = 16,
        device: str | torch.device | None = None,
        cfg: Any | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(model, name="sdrm", **kwargs)
        cfg_obj = cfg or kwargs.get("comp_config")

        self.total_param_ratio = max(
            0.05,
            min(
                float(
                    total_param_ratio
                    or _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "total_param_ratio", _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "ratio", 0.7))
                ),
                1.0,
            ),
        )
        self.min_rank = max(1, int(min_rank or _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "min_rank", 8)))
        self.skip_attention_qkv = bool(
            skip_attention_qkv
            if skip_attention_qkv is not None
            else _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "skip_attention_qkv", False)
        )
        self.target_attention_only = bool(
            target_attention_only
            if target_attention_only is not None
            else _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "target_attention_only", False)
        )
        self.use_lora = bool(use_lora or _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "use_lora", False) or (lora_r > 0))
        self.lora_r = int(lora_r or _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "lora_r", 0))
        self.lora_alpha = float(lora_alpha or _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "lora_alpha", 1.0))
        self.target_modules = target_modules
        self.max_error = float(max_error or _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "max_error", 0.50))
        self.fallback_to_original = bool(
            fallback_to_original
            if fallback_to_original is not None
            else _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "fallback_to_original", True)
        )
        self.min_numel = max(1, int(min_numel or _cfg_get(cfg_obj, "min_numel", 16)))
        self.protect_output_proj: bool = bool(_cfg_get(cfg_obj, "protect_output_proj", True))

        # Target device derivation
        if device is not None:
            try:
                self.target_device = torch.device(device)
            except Exception:
                self.target_device = (
                    next(model.parameters()).device
                    if list(model.parameters())
                    else torch.device("cpu")
                )
        else:
            self.target_device = (
                next(model.parameters()).device if list(model.parameters()) else torch.device("cpu")
            )

        # Diagnostics & Tracking
        self.visited_modules: set[int] = set()
        self.compressed_layers: list[str] = []
        self.protected_layers: list[str] = []
        self.skipped_layers: list[str] = []
        self.fallback_layers: list[str] = []
        self.failed_layers: list[str] = []
        self.layer_errors: dict[str, float] = {}
        self.replaced_layers: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def _is_gqa_asymmetric(self, name: str, module: nn.Module) -> bool:
        """Check if layer belongs to an attention projection in a GQA architecture."""
        cfg = getattr(self.model, "config", None)
        num_heads = getattr(
            cfg, "num_attention_heads", getattr(module, "num_attention_heads", None)
        )
        num_kv_heads = getattr(
            cfg, "num_key_value_heads", getattr(module, "num_key_value_heads", None)
        )
        is_gqa = num_heads is not None and num_kv_heads is not None and num_kv_heads < num_heads

        name_l = name.lower()
        is_attn_qkv = any(
            p in name_l
            for p in [
                "q_proj",
                "k_proj",
                "v_proj",
                "c_attn",
                "query",
                "key",
                "value",
                "q_lin",
                "k_lin",
                "v_lin",
                "self_attn.q",
                "self_attn.k",
                "self_attn.v",
            ]
        )
        return (is_gqa or self.skip_attention_qkv) and is_attn_qkv

    def _is_target_module(self, name: str, module: nn.Module) -> bool:
        name_l = name.lower()
        # 1. Protection for critical / classification / head / pooler / embedding layers
        PROTECTED_ALWAYS = [
            "classifier",
            "score",
            "lm_head",
            "pooler",
            "embedding",
            "cls_head",
            "head",
            "logits_processor",
        ]
        ATTENTION_OUTPUT = ["out_lin", "out_proj", "o_proj", "c_proj", "output.dense"]

        if any(k in name_l for k in PROTECTED_ALWAYS):
            self.protected_layers.append(name)
            return False

        if self.protect_output_proj and any(k in name_l for k in ATTENTION_OUTPUT):
            self.protected_layers.append(name)
            return False

        # Target attention only filter
        if self.target_attention_only:
            attn_keywords = [
                "attn",
                "attention",
                "q_proj",
                "k_proj",
                "v_proj",
                "o_proj",
                "c_attn",
                "c_proj",
                "query",
                "key",
                "value",
            ]
            if not any(k in name_l for k in attn_keywords):
                return False

        # 2. GQA-aware skipping
        if self._is_gqa_asymmetric(name, module):
            self.skipped_layers.append(name)
            return False

        # 3. Check linear or Conv1D nature
        base_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
        cls_name = base_mod.__class__.__name__
        raw_w = getattr(base_mod, "weight", None)
        if raw_w is None or not isinstance(raw_w, torch.Tensor):
            return False

        is_conv1d = "conv1d" in cls_name.lower() or hasattr(base_mod, "nf")
        is_linear_like = isinstance(base_mod, nn.Linear) or is_conv1d
        if not is_linear_like or isinstance(base_mod, SVDLinear):
            return False

        # 4. Tiny layer guard
        if raw_w.numel() < self.min_numel:
            self.skipped_layers.append(name)
            return False

        # 5. Respect framework compatibility rules
        if not should_compress_linear(self.model, name):
            self.protected_layers.append(name)
            return False

        # 6. User-defined explicit target modules
        if self.target_modules is not None:
            return any(t in name for t in self.target_modules)
        return True

    def compress_linear(
        self,
        layer: nn.Module,
        rank: int,
    ) -> SVDLinear | None:
        """Decompose a single linear or Conv1D layer into SVDLinear in FP32 with validation."""
        base_layer = getattr(layer, "base_layer", layer)
        raw_w = base_layer.weight.data
        cls_name = base_layer.__class__.__name__
        is_conv1d = "conv1d" in cls_name.lower() or hasattr(base_layer, "nf")

        if is_conv1d:
            W = raw_w.t().contiguous().float()
            out_f, in_f = W.shape
        else:
            W = raw_w.contiguous().float()
            out_f = getattr(base_layer, "out_features", W.shape[0])
            in_f = getattr(base_layer, "in_features", W.shape[1])

        norm_orig = torch.norm(W, p="fro").item()
        if norm_orig < 1e-4:
            return None

        max_r = min(out_f, in_f)
        param_cap = max(1, (in_f * out_f) // (in_f + out_f) - 1)

        if self.min_rank > max_r - 1:
            logger.warning(
                "SDRM: min_rank=%d exceeds max_r=%d for %s; skipping",
                self.min_rank,
                max_r - 1,
                cls_name,
            )
            return None

        min_rank_effective = min(self.min_rank, max_r - 1, param_cap)
        r = max(min_rank_effective, min(rank, max_r - 1, param_cap))

        if r >= max_r:
            logger.debug(
                "SDRM: rank %d >= max_r %d; skipping layer for no parameter reduction",
                r,
                max_r,
            )
            return None

        device = base_layer.weight.device
        dtype = base_layer.weight.dtype

        try:
            U, S, Vt = torch.linalg.svd(W, full_matrices=False)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("SDRM SVD decomposition failure: %s", e)
            return None

        sqrt_S = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(S[:r], min=1e-12))
        U_r = (U[:, :r] * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0)).to(dtype=dtype, device=device)
        V_r = (sqrt_S.unsqueeze(1) * Vt[:r, :]).to(dtype=dtype, device=device)

        has_base_layer = hasattr(layer, "base_layer")
        has_existing_lora = hasattr(layer, "lora_A") and hasattr(layer, "lora_B")
        effective_lora_r = (
            0
            if has_base_layer
            else (
                getattr(layer, "r", self.lora_r)
                if (has_existing_lora and getattr(layer, "r", 0) > 0)
                else self.lora_r
            )
        )

        svd_layer = SVDLinear(
            in_features=in_f,
            out_features=out_f,
            rank=r,
            bias=base_layer.bias is not None,
            dtype=dtype,
            device=device,
            lora_r=effective_lora_r if (self.use_lora or has_existing_lora) else 0,
            lora_alpha=self.lora_alpha,
        )
        svd_layer.set_low_rank_factors(U_r, V_r)
        if base_layer.bias is not None:
            svd_layer.bias.data.copy_(base_layer.bias.data)

        # Preserve existing LoRA adapters when replacing full module
        if not has_base_layer and has_existing_lora and svd_layer.use_lora:
            try:
                src_lA = getattr(layer.lora_A, "weight", layer.lora_A)
                src_lB = getattr(layer.lora_B, "weight", layer.lora_B)
                dst_lA = getattr(svd_layer.lora_A, "weight", svd_layer.lora_A)
                dst_lB = getattr(svd_layer.lora_B, "weight", svd_layer.lora_B)
                if (
                    hasattr(src_lA, "data")
                    and hasattr(dst_lA, "data")
                    and src_lA.shape == dst_lA.shape
                ):
                    dst_lA.data.copy_(src_lA.data)
                if (
                    hasattr(src_lB, "data")
                    and hasattr(dst_lB, "data")
                    and src_lB.shape == dst_lB.shape
                ):
                    dst_lB.data.copy_(src_lB.data)
            except Exception as e_lora:
                logger.warning("Could not copy existing LoRA adapters in SDRM: %s", e_lora)

        # Frobenius reconstruction error check
        W_rec = torch.matmul(U_r.float(), V_r.float())
        norm_orig_clamped = torch.norm(W, p="fro").clamp_min(1e-8)
        rel_err = (torch.norm(W - W_rec, p="fro") / norm_orig_clamped).item()

        is_invalid = torch.isnan(W_rec).any() or torch.isinf(W_rec).any()
        if rel_err > self.max_error:
            logger.warning(
                "SDRM: reconstruction error %.4f exceeded threshold %.4f.",
                rel_err,
                self.max_error,
            )
            is_invalid = True

        if is_invalid and self.fallback_to_original:
            return None

        svd_layer.reconstruction_error = rel_err
        return svd_layer

    def compress(self, **kwargs: Any) -> tuple[nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
        """Compress linear layers using budget-proportional rank assignment."""
        self.layer_errors = {}
        self.replaced_layers = []
        self.visited_modules.clear()
        self.compressed_layers.clear()
        self.protected_layers.clear()
        self.skipped_layers.clear()
        self.fallback_layers.clear()
        self.failed_layers.clear()

        target_layers = [
            (name, mod)
            for name, mod in self.model.named_modules()
            if self._is_target_module(name, mod)
        ]

        if not target_layers:
            logger.warning("SDRM: No compressible linear layers found.")
            return self.model, self.get_compression_stats()

        for name, module in target_layers:
            mod_id = id(module)
            if mod_id in self.visited_modules:
                logger.debug("SDRM: Skipping tied module %s", name)
                self.skipped_layers.append(name)
                continue
            self.visited_modules.add(mod_id)

            try:
                base_m = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
                raw_w = base_m.weight.data
                cls_name = base_m.__class__.__name__
                is_conv1d = "conv1d" in cls_name.lower() or hasattr(base_m, "nf")
                out_f = (
                    raw_w.shape[1] if is_conv1d else getattr(base_m, "out_features", raw_w.shape[0])
                )
                in_f = (
                    raw_w.shape[0] if is_conv1d else getattr(base_m, "in_features", raw_w.shape[1])
                )

                params = in_f * out_f
                allowed = params * self.total_param_ratio
                rank = max(self.min_rank, int(allowed / max(in_f + out_f, 1)))

                svd_layer = self.compress_linear(module, rank=rank)
                if svd_layer is not None:
                    err = getattr(svd_layer, "reconstruction_error", 0.0)
                    self.layer_errors[name] = err
                    self.replaced_layers.append(
                        {"name": name, "rank": svd_layer.rank, "error": err}
                    )
                    if hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                        module.base_layer = svd_layer
                        if hasattr(module, "lora_A") and module.lora_A is not None:
                            for p in (
                                module.lora_A.parameters()
                                if hasattr(module.lora_A, "parameters")
                                else [module.lora_A]
                            ):
                                p.requires_grad = True
                        if hasattr(module, "lora_B") and module.lora_B is not None:
                            for p in (
                                module.lora_B.parameters()
                                if hasattr(module.lora_B, "parameters")
                                else [module.lora_B]
                            ):
                                p.requires_grad = True
                    else:
                        replace_module(self.model, name, svd_layer)
                    self.compressed_layers.append(name)
                else:
                    self.fallback_layers.append(name)
                    for p in module.parameters():
                        p.requires_grad = False
            except Exception as e_comp:
                logger.warning("Failed to compress %s: %s", name, e_comp)
                self.failed_layers.append(name)
                for p in module.parameters():
                    p.requires_grad = False

        # Post-compression forward sanity check
        forward_check_success = True
        try:
            with torch.no_grad():
                dummy_input = torch.randint(0, 100, (1, 8), device=self.target_device)
                self.model(dummy_input)
        except Exception as ex_sanity:
            logger.warning("SDRM post-compression forward sanity check warning: %s", ex_sanity)
            forward_check_success = False

        self._compressed_params = self._count_params(self.model)
        avg_err = (
            (sum(self.layer_errors.values()) / len(self.layer_errors)) if self.layer_errors else 0.0
        )
        stats = self.get_compression_stats()
        stats.update(
            {
                "total_param_ratio": self.total_param_ratio,
                "compressed_layers": self.compressed_layers,
                "compressed_layer_count": len(self.compressed_layers),
                "protected_layers": self.protected_layers,
                "protected_layer_count": len(self.protected_layers),
                "skipped_layers": self.skipped_layers,
                "skipped_layer_count": len(self.skipped_layers),
                "fallback_layers": self.fallback_layers,
                "fallback_layer_count": len(self.fallback_layers),
                "failed_layers": self.failed_layers,
                "failed_layer_count": len(self.failed_layers),
                "layer_errors": self.layer_errors,
                "avg_reconstruction_error": avg_err,
                "forward_check_success": forward_check_success,
                "min_rank": self.min_rank,
                "skip_attention_qkv": self.skip_attention_qkv,
                "target_attention_only": self.target_attention_only,
                "use_lora": self.use_lora,
                "lora_r": self.lora_r,
                "method": "sdrm",
            }
        )
        self.stats = stats
        return self.model, stats

        if self._is_target_module(name, mod)

    if not target_layers:

    for name, module in target_layers:

            out_f = (
                raw_w.shape[1] if is_conv1d else getattr(base_m, "out_features", raw_w.shape[0])
            )
            in_f = (
                raw_w.shape[0] if is_conv1d else getattr(base_m, "in_features", raw_w.shape[1])
            )

            params = in_f * out_f
            allowed = params * self.total_param_ratio
            rank = max(self.min_rank, int(allowed / max(in_f + out_f, 1)))

            svd_layer = self.compress_linear(module, rank=rank)
            if svd_layer is not None:
                err = getattr(svd_layer, "reconstruction_error", 0.0)
                self.layer_errors[name] = err
                self.replaced_layers.append(
                    {"name": name, "rank": svd_layer.rank, "error": err}
                )
                if hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                    module.base_layer = svd_layer
                    if hasattr(module, "lora_A") and module.lora_A is not None:
                        for p in (
                            module.lora_A.parameters()
                            if hasattr(module.lora_A, "parameters")
                            else [module.lora_A]
                        ):
                            p.requires_grad = True
                    if hasattr(module, "lora_B") and module.lora_B is not None:
                        for p in (
                            module.lora_B.parameters()
                            if hasattr(module.lora_B, "parameters")
                            else [module.lora_B]
                        ):
                            p.requires_grad = True
                else:
                    replace_module(self.model, name, svd_layer)
                self.compressed_layers.append(name)
            else:
                self.fallback_layers.append(name)
                for p in module.parameters():
                    p.requires_grad = False
        except Exception as e_comp:
            logger.warning("Failed to compress %s: %s", name, e_comp)
            self.failed_layers.append(name)
            for p in module.parameters():
                p.requires_grad = False

    # Post-compression forward sanity check
    forward_check_success = True
    try:
        with torch.no_grad():
            dummy_input = torch.randint(0, 100, (1, 8), device=self.target_device)
            self.model(dummy_input)
    except Exception as ex_sanity:
        logger.warning("SDRM post-compression forward sanity check warning: %s", ex_sanity)
        forward_check_success = False

    self._compressed_params = self._count_params(self.model)
    avg_err = (
        (sum(self.layer_errors.values()) / len(self.layer_errors)) if self.layer_errors else 0.0
    )
    stats = self.get_compression_stats()
    stats.update(
        {
            "total_param_ratio": self.total_param_ratio,
            "compressed_layers": self.compressed_layers,
            "compressed_layer_count": len(self.compressed_layers),
            "protected_layers": self.protected_layers,
            "protected_layer_count": len(self.protected_layers),
            "skipped_layers": self.skipped_layers,
            "skipped_layer_count": len(self.skipped_layers),
            "fallback_layers": self.fallback_layers,
            "fallback_layer_count": len(self.fallback_layers),
            "failed_layers": self.failed_layers,
            "failed_layer_count": len(self.failed_layers),
            "layer_errors": self.layer_errors,
            "avg_reconstruction_error": avg_err,
            "forward_check_success": forward_check_success,
            "min_rank": self.min_rank,
            "skip_attention_qkv": self.skip_attention_qkv,
            "target_attention_only": self.target_attention_only,
            "use_lora": self.use_lora,
            "lora_r": self.lora_r,
            "method": "sdrm",
        }
    )
    self.stats = stats
    return self.model, stats

def compress_linear(
    self,
    layer: nn.Module,
    rank: int,
) -> SVDLinear | None:
    """Decompose a single linear or Conv1D layer into SVDLinear in FP32 with validation."""
    base_layer = getattr(layer, "base_layer", layer)
    raw_w = base_layer.weight.data
    cls_name = base_layer.__class__.__name__
    is_conv1d = "conv1d" in cls_name.lower() or hasattr(base_layer, "nf")

    if is_conv1d:
        W = raw_w.t().contiguous().float()
        out_f, in_f = W.shape
    else:
        W = raw_w.contiguous().float()
        out_f = getattr(base_layer, "out_features", W.shape[0])
        in_f = getattr(base_layer, "in_features", W.shape[1])

    norm_orig = torch.norm(W, p="fro").item()
    if norm_orig < 1e-4:
        return None

    max_r = min(out_f, in_f)
    param_cap = max(1, (in_f * out_f) // (in_f + out_f) - 1)

    if self.min_rank > max_r - 1:
        logger.warning(
            "SDRM: min_rank=%d exceeds max_r=%d for %s; skipping",
            self.min_rank,
            max_r - 1,
            cls_name,
        )
        return None

    min_rank_effective = min(self.min_rank, max_r - 1, param_cap)
    r = max(min_rank_effective, min(rank, max_r - 1, param_cap))

    if r >= max_r:
        logger.debug(
            "SDRM: rank %d >= max_r %d; skipping layer for no parameter reduction",
            r,
            max_r,
        )
        return None

    device = base_layer.weight.device
    dtype = base_layer.weight.dtype

    try:
        U, S, Vt = torch.linalg.svd(W, full_matrices=False)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning("SDRM SVD decomposition failure: %s", e)
        return None

    sqrt_S = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(S[:r], min=1e-12))
    U_r = (U[:, :r] * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0)).to(dtype=dtype, device=device)
    V_r = (sqrt_S.unsqueeze(1) * Vt[:r, :]).to(dtype=dtype, device=device)

    has_base_layer = hasattr(layer, "base_layer")
    has_existing_lora = hasattr(layer, "lora_A") and hasattr(layer, "lora_B")
    effective_lora_r = (
        0
        if has_base_layer
        else (
            getattr(layer, "r", self.lora_r)
            if (has_existing_lora and getattr(layer, "r", 0) > 0)
            else self.lora_r
        )
    )

    svd_layer = SVDLinear(
        in_features=in_f,
        out_features=out_f,
        rank=r,
        bias=base_layer.bias is not None,
        dtype=dtype,
        device=device,
        lora_r=effective_lora_r if (self.use_lora or has_existing_lora) else 0,
        lora_alpha=self.lora_alpha,
    )
    svd_layer.set_low_rank_factors(U_r, V_r)
    if base_layer.bias is not None:
        svd_layer.bias.data.copy_(base_layer.bias.data)

    # Preserve existing LoRA adapters when replacing full module
    if not has_base_layer and has_existing_lora and svd_layer.use_lora:
        try:
            src_lA = getattr(layer.lora_A, "weight", layer.lora_A)
            src_lB = getattr(layer.lora_B, "weight", layer.lora_B)
            dst_lA = getattr(svd_layer.lora_A, "weight", svd_layer.lora_A)
            dst_lB = getattr(svd_layer.lora_B, "weight", svd_layer.lora_B)
            if (
                hasattr(src_lA, "data")
                and hasattr(dst_lA, "data")
                and src_lA.shape == dst_lA.shape
            ):
                dst_lA.data.copy_(src_lA.data)
            if (
                hasattr(src_lB, "data")
                and hasattr(dst_lB, "data")
                and src_lB.shape == dst_lB.shape
            ):
                dst_lB.data.copy_(src_lB.data)
        except Exception as e_lora:
            logger.warning("Could not copy existing LoRA adapters in SDRM: %s", e_lora)

    # Frobenius reconstruction error check
    W_rec = torch.matmul(U_r.float(), V_r.float())
    norm_orig_clamped = torch.norm(W, p="fro").clamp_min(1e-8)
    rel_err = (torch.norm(W - W_rec, p="fro") / norm_orig_clamped).item()

    is_invalid = torch.isnan(W_rec).any() or torch.isinf(W_rec).any()
    if rel_err > self.max_error:
        logger.warning(
            "SDRM: reconstruction error %.4f exceeded threshold %.4f.",
            rel_err,
            self.max_error,
        )
        is_invalid = True

    if is_invalid and self.fallback_to_original:
        return None

    svd_layer.reconstruction_error = rel_err
    return svd_layer

@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("slim")
@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("slim_compressor")
class SLiMCompressor(BaseCompressor):
    is_custom_attention: bool = True
    """
    SLiM Compressor: One-shot joint b-bit quantization, 2:4 structured sparsity, and low-rank residual recovery.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: nn.Module,
        bits: int = 4,
        sparsity: float = 0.5,
        rank: int = 8,
        structured_24: bool = True,
        target_attention_only: bool = False,
        max_error: float = 0.5,
        fallback_to_original: bool = True,  # Fix 1: Default changed to True
        target_modules: list[str] | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(model, name="slim", **kwargs)
        cfg = kwargs.get("comp_config", kwargs.get("cfg"))
        if cfg is not None:
            bits = _cfg_get(cfg, "slim_bits", _cfg_get(cfg, "bits", bits))
            sparsity = _cfg_get(cfg, "slim_sparsity", _cfg_get(cfg, "sparsity", sparsity))
            rank = _cfg_get(cfg, "slim_rank", _cfg_get(cfg, "rank", rank))
            structured_24 = _cfg_get(
                cfg, "slim_structured_24", _cfg_get(cfg, "structured_24", structured_24)
            )
            max_error = _cfg_get(cfg, "max_error", max_error)
            fallback_to_original = _cfg_get(cfg, "fallback_to_original", fallback_to_original)
            target_attention_only = _cfg_get(cfg, "target_attention_only", target_attention_only)

        if "fallback_to_original" in kwargs:
            fallback_to_original = bool(kwargs["fallback_to_original"])

        self.bits = int(bits)
        self.sparsity = max(0.0, min(float(sparsity), 0.95))
        self.rank = max(1, int(rank))
        self.structured_24 = structured_24
        self.target_attention_only = bool(target_attention_only)
        self.max_error = float(max_error)
        self.fallback_to_original = bool(fallback_to_original)
        self.target_modules = target_modules
        self.layer_errors: dict[str, float] = {}
        self.stats: dict[str, Any] = {}

    def _is_target_module(self, name: str, module: nn.Module) -> bool:
        """
        Fix 4: Unified critical-layer protection delegated to should_compress_linear.
        Eliminates duplicate keyword matching.
        """
        name_l = name.lower()
        if self.target_attention_only:
            attn_keywords = [
                "attn",
                "attention",
                "q_proj",
                "k_proj",
                "v_proj",
                "o_proj",
                "c_attn",
                "c_proj",
                "query",
                "key",
                "value",
            ]
            if not any(k in name_l for k in attn_keywords):
                return False

        base_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
        cls_name = base_mod.__class__.__name__.lower()
        # Fix 2: Reliable Conv1D check using class name and hasattr(nf)
        is_linear_like = (
            isinstance(base_mod, nn.Linear) or "conv1d" in cls_name or hasattr(base_mod, "nf")
        )
        if not is_linear_like:
            return False
        if not should_compress_linear(self.model, name):
            return False
        if self.target_modules is None:
            return True
        return any(t in name for t in self.target_modules)

    def _quantize(self, W: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Quantizes weight to b-bit representation (biases remain unquantized)."""
        if self.bits >= 32:
            return W
        min_val = W.min()
        max_val = W.max()
        if (max_val - min_val).abs() < 1e-6:
            max_val = min_val + 1e-6
        scale = (max_val - min_val) / (2.0**self.bits - 1.0)
        W_q = torch.round((W - min_val) / scale) * scale + min_val
        return W_q

    def compress(self, **kwargs: Any) -> tuple[nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
        """Executes SLiM compression pipeline across all Linear and Conv1D layers."""
        self.layer_errors = {}
        pruned_layers_count = 0
        total_svd_energy = 0.0

        for name, module in self.model.named_modules():
            if self._is_target_module(name, module):
                base_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
                raw_w = base_mod.weight.data
                cls_name = base_mod.__class__.__name__.lower()
                # Fix 2: Check for Conv1D via class name and nf attribute
                is_conv1d = "conv1d" in cls_name or hasattr(base_mod, "nf")
                device = raw_w.device
                dtype = raw_w.dtype

                W = raw_w.t().contiguous().clone().float() if is_conv1d else raw_w.clone().float()

                # 1. Quantize (Weights only; biases are preserved in full precision to avoid drift)
                W_q = self._quantize(W)

                # 2. Apply 2:4 structured sparsity or magnitude sparsity
                if self.structured_24:
                    W_sp, _ = apply_24_structured_mask(W_q, saliency=torch.abs(W_q), dim=1)
                else:
                    flat = W_q.abs().reshape(-1)
                    k = max(1, int(flat.numel() * (1.0 - self.sparsity)))
                    thr = torch.topk(flat, k, largest=True).values[-1]
                    mask = (W_q.abs() >= thr).float()
                    W_sp = W_q * mask

                # 3. Low-Rank Residual Correction
                residual = W - W_sp
                try:
                    U, S, Vh = torch.linalg.svd(residual, full_matrices=False)
                    r = min(self.rank, len(S))
                    if r > 0:
                        correction = torch.matmul(U[:, :r] * S[:r].unsqueeze(0), Vh[:r, :])
                        total_svd_energy += torch.norm(correction).item()
                        W_final = W_sp + correction
                    else:
                        W_final = W_sp
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.debug("SVD residual correction exception in %s: %s", name, e)
                    W_final = W_sp

                # Relative Frobenius error check
                norm_orig = torch.norm(W, p="fro")
                rel_err = (torch.norm(W - W_final, p="fro") / (norm_orig + 1e-8)).item()
                self.layer_errors[name] = rel_err

                # Fix 3: Always log a warning when reconstruction error exceeds max_error
                if rel_err > self.max_error:
                    logger.warning(
                        "SLiM reconstruction error %.4f on %s exceeded threshold %.4f%s",
                        rel_err,
                        name,
                        self.max_error,
                        (
                            ". Skipping (fallback to original)."
                            if self.fallback_to_original
                            else ". Proceeding with compressed weight."
                        ),
                    )
                    if self.fallback_to_original:
                        logger.warning(
                            "Fallback triggered for %s. Layer is kept original and NOT wrapped in LoRA. It will not be fine-tuned.",
                            name,
                        )
                        for p in module.parameters():
                            p.requires_grad = False
                        continue

                final_w = W_final.t().contiguous() if is_conv1d else W_final
                base_mod.weight.data = final_w.to(dtype=dtype, device=device)
                compressed_layer = base_mod
                # Preserve existing LoRA adapter weights if the source module has them
                if (
                    hasattr(module, "lora_A")
                    and hasattr(module, "lora_B")
                    and module.lora_A is not None
                    and module.lora_B is not None
                ):
                    src_lA = getattr(module.lora_A, "weight", module.lora_A)
                    src_lB = getattr(module.lora_B, "weight", module.lora_B)
                    if hasattr(compressed_layer, "lora_A") and compressed_layer.lora_A is not None:
                        if (
                            hasattr(src_lA, "data")
                            and src_lA.shape == compressed_layer.lora_A.shape
                        ):
                            compressed_layer.lora_A.data.copy_(src_lA.data)
                    if hasattr(compressed_layer, "lora_B") and compressed_layer.lora_B is not None:
                        if (
                            hasattr(src_lB, "data")
                            and src_lB.shape == compressed_layer.lora_B.shape
                        ):
                            compressed_layer.lora_B.data.copy_(src_lB.data)

                # Determine if module is wrapped (LoRALinear) or standalone
                is_wrapped = hasattr(module, "base_layer")
                if is_wrapped:
                    module.base_layer = compressed_layer
                    new_module = module
                else:
                    new_module = compressed_layer
                    replace_module(self.model, name, new_module)
                pruned_layers_count += 1

        self._compressed_params = self._count_params(self.model)
        stats = self.get_compression_stats()
        # Fix 6: Store max_error and fallback_to_original in stats
        stats.update(
            {
                "pruned_layers": pruned_layers_count,
                "quant_bits": self.bits,
                "rank": self.rank,
                "structured_24": self.structured_24,
                "total_svd_energy": total_svd_energy,
                "layer_errors": self.layer_errors,
                "max_error": self.max_error,
                "fallback_to_original": self.fallback_to_original,
                "target_attention_only": self.target_attention_only,
                "biases_quantized": False,  # Fix 5: Explicitly document bias policy
                "method": "slim_quant_sparse_lowrank",
            }
        )
        self.stats = stats
        return self.model, stats

class STEFakeQuantize(torch.autograd.Function):
    """
    Straight-Through Estimator (STE) fake-quantization autograd function.
    Clamps inputs to [qmin, qmax] in discrete integer space, de-quantizes back,
    and passes gradients through uninhibited across all channels.
    """

    @staticmethod
    def forward(
        ctx: Any,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        scale: torch.Tensor,
        zero_point: torch.Tensor,
        qmin: float | torch.Tensor,
        qmax: float | torch.Tensor,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        ctx.save_for_backward(x, scale, zero_point)
        # Quantize, clamp to discrete range, and dequantize
        q = torch.clamp(torch.round(x / scale) + zero_point, qmin, qmax)
        dq = (q - zero_point) * scale
        return dq

    @staticmethod
    def backward(ctx: Any, grad_output: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor | None, ...]:
        # Straight-Through Estimator passes gradient unmodified
        grad_x = grad_output.clone()
        return grad_x, None, None, None, None

Straight-Through Estimator (STE) fake-quantization autograd function. Clamps inputs to [qmin, qmax] in discrete integer space, de-quantizes back, and passes gradients through uninhibited across all channels.

Define a formula for differentiating the operation with backward mode automatic differentiation.

This function is to be overridden by all subclasses. (Defining this function is equivalent to defining the vjp function.)

It must accept a context :attr:ctx as the first argument, followed by as many outputs as the :func:forward returned (None will be passed in for non tensor outputs of the forward function), and it should return as many tensors, as there were inputs to :func:forward. Each argument is the gradient w.r.t the given output, and each returned value should be the gradient w.r.t. the corresponding input. If an input is not a Tensor or is a Tensor not requiring grads, you can just pass None as a gradient for that input.

The context can be used to retrieve tensors saved during the forward pass. It also has an attribute :attr:ctx.needs_input_grad as a tuple of booleans representing whether each input needs gradient. E.g., :func:backward will have ctx.needs_input_grad[0] = True if the first input to :func:forward needs gradient computed w.r.t. the output.

Define the forward of the custom autograd Function.

This function is to be overridden by all subclasses. There are two ways to define forward:

Usage 1 (Combined forward and ctx)::

@staticmethod
def forward(ctx: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    pass
  • It must accept a context ctx as the first argument, followed by any number of arguments (tensors or other types).
  • See :ref:combining-forward-context for more details

Usage 2 (Separate forward and ctx)::

@staticmethod
def forward(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    pass


@staticmethod
def setup_context(ctx: Any, inputs: Tuple[Any, ...], output: Any) -> None:
    pass
  • The forward no longer accepts a ctx argument.
  • Instead, you must also override the :meth:torch.autograd.Function.setup_context staticmethod to handle setting up the ctx object. output is the output of the forward, inputs are a Tuple of inputs to the forward.
  • See :ref:extending-autograd for more details

The context can be used to store arbitrary data that can be then retrieved during the backward pass. Tensors should not be stored directly on ctx (though this is not currently enforced for backward compatibility). Instead, tensors should be saved either with :func:ctx.save_for_backward if they are intended to be used in backward (equivalently, vjp) or :func:ctx.save_for_forward if they are intended to be used for in jvp.
